crystal_maiden_glacial_guard.name: Glacial Guard
crystal_maiden_glacial_guard.description: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.name: Crystal Nova
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.description: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.facet_crystal_maiden_glacial_guard: Crystal Nova has increased radius and grants allied heroes a physical damage barrier. Barrier is increased for Crystal Maiden.
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.lore: The air temperature around Rylai drops rapidly, chilling all around her to the core.
crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.note0: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.

crystal_maiden_frostbite.name: Frostbite
crystal_maiden_frostbite.description: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals %creep_multiplier%x damage to non-ancient creeps.
crystal_maiden_frostbite.lore: Rylai channels winds from the Blueheart Glacier, imprisoning attackers in thick blocks of ice.

crystal_maiden_arcane_aura.name: Arcane Aura
crystal_maiden_arcane_aura.description:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a %proximity_bonus_radius% radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
crystal_maiden_arcane_aura.lore: Cold is the essence of magic, and the presence of the frost mage Rylai allows her allies to cast with abundance.

crystal_maiden_freezing_field.name: Freezing Field
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.description: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.lore: Once the place of her exile, Icewrack has become an anchor for Rylai's frigid onslaught.
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.note0: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.scepter_description: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.abilitydraft_note: Frostbite must be drafted for Aghanim's Scepter upgrade to work.

dragon_knight_dragon_blood.name: Dragon Blood
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.description:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  

Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_corrosive_dragon: Attacks are filled with lethal poison that affects enemy units and structures, reducing armor and dealing physical damage over time.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_fire_dragon: Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_frost_dragon: Attacks are filled with frost that affects enemy units, slowing movement speed, attack speed, and reducing health restoration.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.lore: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

dragon_knight_breathe_fire.name: Breathe Fire
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.description: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.lore: Knight Davion's breath has become that of the mighty Eldwurm Slyrak, remembered for burning numerous other knights to a crisp.
dragon_knight_breathe_fire.note0: Hits creatures at a slightly greater distance.

dragon_knight_dragon_tail.name: Dragon Tail
dragon_knight_dragon_tail.description: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
dragon_knight_dragon_tail.lore: Davion's combination of dragon talents and knightly skills makes him a vicious opponent in melee combat.

dragon_knight_dragon_blood.name: Dragon Blood
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.description:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  

Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_corrosive_dragon: Attacks are filled with lethal poison that affects enemy units and structures, reducing armor and dealing physical damage over time.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_fire_dragon: Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.facet_dragon_knight_frost_dragon: Attacks are filled with frost that affects enemy units, slowing movement speed, attack speed, and reducing health restoration.
dragon_knight_dragon_blood.lore: Slyrak's blood still courses through Davion's veins, giving him twice the vitality of an ordinary knight.

dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.name: Elder Dragon Form
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.description:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. 

Level 1 <font color='#9acd32'>Green</font>: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 <font color='#FF0000'>Red</font>: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 <font color='#87ceeb'>Blue</font>: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.scepter_description: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.lore: The power of the ancient dragon that lies dormant within Davion is unleashed, combining the power of a legendary knight with the power of a legendary dragon.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.note0: The damage from poison attacks is lethal.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.note1: The cooldown of some items depends on what type of attack the hero had when using them.

lone_druid_spirit_bear.name: Summon Spirit Bear
lone_druid_spirit_bear.lore: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.description:
Summons a mighty spirit bear.

The bear cannot attack if the distance to its owner exceeds %distance_silence%. If the bear dies, the hero takes damage equal to %backlash_damage%%% of their maximum health.\nThe bear has no attributes and cannot carry items.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note0: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note1: Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note2: Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note3: Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note4: Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.facet_lone_druid_unbearable: Increases the distance from Lone Druid at which the Spirit Bear can attack.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.return_description: Channels for %channel_tooltip% seconds and then teleports the Spirit Bear back to the Lone Druid.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.return_scepter_description: Allows Spirit Bear to attack at any range from Lone Druid, and to survive if Lone Druid dies.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_description:
Allows Spirit Bear to Entangle enemy heroes once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

Spirit Bear's attacks are permanently empowered, making them apply %spirit_bear_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note0: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note1: Enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note2: Stacks are only applied to enemy heroes, creep heroes, and Roshan.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.demolish_description: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.spirit_link_description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.spirit_link_lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.fetch_description: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every %tick_rate%s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.

lone_druid_entangle.name: Entangle
lone_druid_entangle.description:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
lone_druid_entangle.scepter_description: Entangle applies %hits_required% stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.
lone_druid_entangle.note0: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
lone_druid_entangle.note1: Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
lone_druid_entangle.note3: Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
lone_druid_entangle.note4: Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.

lone_druid_spirit_link.name: Spirit Link
lone_druid_spirit_link.description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
lone_druid_spirit_link.facet_lone_druid_bear_with_me: Shared Armor increased. Damage dealt by either the Spirit Bear or Lone Druid will heal the other.
lone_druid_spirit_link.facet_lone_druid_unbearable: Only damage dealt by Spirit Bear heals Lone Druid.
lone_druid_spirit_link.scepter_description:
Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for %duration%s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by %active_bonus%%%. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around.

The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.
lone_druid_spirit_link.lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.

lone_druid_savage_roar.name: Savage Roar
lone_druid_savage_roar.lore: Sylla studies and masters the arts of the lost Bear Clan, enhancing his attunement with the wild.
lone_druid_savage_roar.description: Hero and his bear let out a savage roar, causing enemies to flee in terror. The movement speed of affected units is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
lone_druid_savage_roar.bear_description: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
lone_druid_savage_roar.shard_description:
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
lone_druid_savage_roar.note0: Cooldown of the hero and the bear is the same.
lone_druid_savage_roar.bear_note0: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
lone_druid_savage_roar.note1: Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.
lone_druid_savage_roar.bear_note1: Cooldown is shared with Lone Druid.

lone_druid_spirit_bear.lore: Sylla's lifelong companion is symbiotic with his spirit and heart, coming to aid him in any time of need.

The bear cannot attack if the distance to its owner exceeds %distance_silence%. If the bear dies, the hero takes damage equal to %backlash_damage%%% of their maximum health.\nThe bear has no attributes and cannot carry items.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note0: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note1: Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note2: Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note3: Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.note4: Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.facet_lone_druid_unbearable: Increases the distance from Lone Druid at which the Spirit Bear can attack.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.return_description: Channels for %channel_tooltip% seconds and then teleports the Spirit Bear back to the Lone Druid.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.return_scepter_description: Allows Spirit Bear to attack at any range from Lone Druid, and to survive if Lone Druid dies.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_description:
Allows Spirit Bear to Entangle enemy heroes once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

Spirit Bear's attacks are permanently empowered, making them apply %spirit_bear_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note0: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note1: Enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.entangle_note2: Stacks are only applied to enemy heroes, creep heroes, and Roshan.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.demolish_description: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.spirit_link_description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.spirit_link_lore: Sylla is emboldened by the presence of his companion, his vitality replenished with each swipe of the Spirit Bear's claws.
lone_druid_spirit_bear.fetch_description: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every %tick_rate%s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.

lone_druid_true_form.name: True Form
lone_druid_true_form.lore: The mighty bear is the king of the forest, possessing the throne through raw power.
lone_druid_true_form.description: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
lone_druid_true_form.facet_lone_druid_bear_with_me: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining increased bonus armor, more health, and improved versions of Entangling Claws and Demolish.
lone_druid_true_form.facet_lone_druid_unbearable: Lone Druid morphs his Spirit Bear into an enraged form that gains bonus armor, attack speed, demolish damage, and a %entangling_claws_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% cooldown on Entangling Claws.
lone_druid_true_form.note0: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Lone Druid was in when the item was used.

windranger_tailwind.name: Tailwind
windranger_tailwind.description: Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.\n\nPassively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
windranger_tailwind.scepter_description: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.

windranger_shackleshot.name: Shackleshot
windranger_shackleshot.description: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
windranger_shackleshot.lore: Windranger's variety of bow skills includes an arrow with thick ropes attached to encumber any escaping target.
windranger_shackleshot.note0: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
windranger_shackleshot.note1: Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.

windranger_powershot.name: Powershot
windranger_powershot.description: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
windranger_powershot.lore: During her early years of training, Lyralei learned to fire powerful arrows that cleaved even trees to reach their targets.
windranger_powershot.note0: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.

windranger_windrun.name: Windrun
windranger_windrun.description: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.
windranger_windrun.lore: Lyralei enchants gusts of winds to fight incoming attacks.

windranger_focusfire.name: Focus Fire
windranger_focusfire.description: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
windranger_focusfire.lore: Lyralei's ability to bombard opponents with a flurry of arrows is unparalleled - even at the expense of accuracy.
windranger_focusfire.note0: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.

drow_ranger_trueshot.name: Precision Aura
drow_ranger_trueshot.description: Grants the owner bonus Agility based on their level and current Agility. Nearby ranged heroes receive %trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%% of the bonus.
drow_ranger_trueshot.lore: Through endless solitary training, Traxex learned to share a fraction of her mastery with any archer.

drow_ranger_frost_arrows.name: Frost Arrows
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.description: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %duration% seconds.
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.scepter_description: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.lore: Ice-encased arrows pierce the silence, chilling their victims to the core.
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.note0: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.

drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.name: Gust
drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.description: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.
drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.lore: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

drow_ranger_multishot.name: Multishot
drow_ranger_multishot.description:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
drow_ranger_multishot.lore: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.
drow_ranger_multishot.note0: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
drow_ranger_multishot.note1: Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.
drow_ranger_multishot.2_custom_description: Channeling. Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying longer duration Frost Arrows.
drow_ranger_multishot.2_custom_lore: In the ranger's youth, learning to fire multiple arrows at once was considered a distracting frivolity. In the war of the Ancients, such technique has become strange necessity.

drow_ranger_marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
drow_ranger_marksmanship.description: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
drow_ranger_marksmanship.lore: The Drow Ranger is the epitome of archery prowess.

witch_doctor_gris_gris.name: Gris-Gris
witch_doctor_gris_gris.description:
The hero receives a Gris-Gris — an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. Its value increases by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip% sec. Using the item will permanently remove it and grant all accumulated gold. 

 To use the item, right-click it and select Use.

witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.name: Paralyzing Cask
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.description: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.facet_witch_doctor_headhunter: Paralyzing Cask deals more damage each bounce.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.lore: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.note0: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.

witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.name: Voodoo Restoration
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.description: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.facet_witch_doctor_voodoo_festeration: Voodoo Restoration deals damage to enemies and only heals Witch Doctor.
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.lore: Zharvakko's tricks can not only charm enemies, but also cure various ailments.

witch_doctor_maledict.name: Maledict
witch_doctor_maledict.description: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled units in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
witch_doctor_maledict.facet_witch_doctor_malpractice: Enemies who die while cursed deal damage equal to %spread_pct%%% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.
witch_doctor_maledict.lore: Certain voodoo magics can make an enemy regret engaging the Witch Doctor.
witch_doctor_maledict.note0: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.

witch_doctor_death_ward.name: Death Ward
witch_doctor_death_ward.description: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
witch_doctor_death_ward.facet_witch_doctor_cleft_death: Death Ward attacks %initial_target_count% targets at once with reduced damage. The secondary target takes %secondary_attack_damage_pct%%% of the damage.
witch_doctor_death_ward.scepter_description: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
witch_doctor_death_ward.lore: Witch Doctor performs a ritualistic dance, one that haunts the dreams of those who live to recount it.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note0: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note1: The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note2: Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.

shadow_fiend_necromastery.name: Necromastery
shadow_fiend_necromastery.description: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
shadow_fiend_necromastery.facet_nevermore_lasting_presence: Every hero kill increases max souls by %max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill% until Shadow Fiend dies.
shadow_fiend_necromastery.lore: Harvested souls swirl in and out of the Abysm, empowering the Shadow Fiend to increase the size of his collection.
shadow_fiend_necromastery.note0: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
shadow_fiend_necromastery.note1: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
shadow_fiend_necromastery.note2: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

shadow_fiend_shadowraze1.name: Shadowraze
shadow_fiend_shadowraze1.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
shadow_fiend_shadowraze1.note0: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

shadow_fiend_shadowraze2.name: Shadowraze
shadow_fiend_shadowraze2.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a short distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
shadow_fiend_shadowraze2.note0: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

shadow_fiend_shadowraze3.name: Shadowraze
shadow_fiend_shadowraze3.description: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a longer distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
shadow_fiend_shadowraze3.note0: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

shadow_fiend_frenzy.name: Feast of Souls
shadow_fiend_frenzy.description: Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.\n\n Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
shadow_fiend_frenzy.note0: Cannot be activated if there are not enough souls.

shadow_fiend_dark_lord.name: Presence of the Dark Lord
shadow_fiend_dark_lord.description: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
shadow_fiend_dark_lord.lore: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one's soul.

shadow_fiend_requiem.name: Requiem of Souls
shadow_fiend_requiem.description:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. 

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
shadow_fiend_requiem.lore: The captured souls of those past slain are released to ravage their former allies.
shadow_fiend_requiem.note0: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% souls in his possession.
shadow_fiend_requiem.note1: Fear and movement slow do not apply when if the Requiem was released on death.

earthshaker_slugger.name: Slugger
earthshaker_slugger.description: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

earthshaker_fissure.name: Fissure
earthshaker_fissure.description: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
earthshaker_fissure.lore: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.
earthshaker_fissure.note0: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
earthshaker_fissure.note1: Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
earthshaker_fissure.shard_description: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
earthshaker_fissure.facet_earthshaker_reverberating_ridge: Enemy heroes stunned by Fissure emit an echo to each nearby unit within a %echoes_radius% radius, dealing damage equal to %echoes_damage_multiplier%%% of Echo Slam's current echo damage.
earthshaker_fissure.abilitydraft_note: Requires drafting Aftershock for Shard upgrade to work.
earthshaker_fissure.2_custom_description: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
earthshaker_fissure.2_custom_lore: The Nishian totem splits the world to its core with tectonic force.

earthshaker_enchant_totem.name: Enchant Totem
earthshaker_enchant_totem.scepter_description: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.
earthshaker_enchant_totem.description: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
earthshaker_enchant_totem.lore: Raigor's gorilla strength can destroy mountains.
earthshaker_enchant_totem.note0: Bonus damage is based on base damage.

earthshaker_aftershock.name: Aftershock
earthshaker_aftershock.description: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
earthshaker_aftershock.lore: The earth trembles beneath the mighty footsteps of Raigor.
earthshaker_aftershock.note0: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.

earthshaker_echo_slam.name: Echo Slam
earthshaker_echo_slam.description: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.
earthshaker_echo_slam.lore: Tectonic plates crack, mountains fold, and foes are crushed by the Echo Slam.

anti-mage_persectur.name: Persecutor
anti-mage_persectur.description: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.
anti-mage_persectur.note0: Full effect if caused by illusions.

anti-mage_mana_break.name: Mana Break
anti-mage_mana_break.description: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
anti-mage_mana_break.lore: A modified technique of the Turstarkuri monks' peaceful ways is to turn magical energies on their owner.
anti-mage_mana_break.note0: Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% effect if caused by illusions.

anti-mage_blink.name: Blink
anti-mage_blink.description: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
anti-mage_blink.lore: In his encounter with the Dead Gods, Anti-Mage learned the value of being elusive.
anti-mage_blink.note0: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

anti-mage_counterspell.name: Counterspell
anti-mage_counterspell.description: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
anti-mage_counterspell.lore: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.

anti-mage_mana_void.name: Mana Void
anti-mage_mana_void.description: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
anti-mage_mana_void.lore: After bringing enemies to their knees, Anti-Mage punishes them for their use of the arcane arts.
anti-mage_mana_void.note0: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.

tidehunter_leviathans_catch.name: Leviathan's Catch
tidehunter_leviathans_catch.description:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
tidehunter_leviathans_catch.note1: Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

tidehunter_gush.name: Gush
tidehunter_gush.description: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
tidehunter_gush.lore: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.
tidehunter_gush.scepter_description: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.
tidehunter_gush.2_custom_description: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
tidehunter_gush.2_custom_lore: During his championship of the Sunken Isles, Leviathan gained mastery over the open sea.

tidehunter_kraken_shell.name: Kraken Shell
tidehunter_kraken_shell.description:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
tidehunter_kraken_shell.facet_tidehunter_kraken_swell: Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.
tidehunter_kraken_shell.lore: Claddish navymen tell tales of a mighty sea-faring beast that suffered spear and sword but continued to lay waste to the fleet.
tidehunter_kraken_shell.note2: Kraken Shell removes most debuffs, even if they are generally not purgable.
tidehunter_kraken_shell.note0: Only damage from player owned sources is counted towards debuff removal.
tidehunter_kraken_shell.note1: The counter will reset if no player owned damage is taken for %damage_reset_interval% seconds.

tidehunter_anchor_smash.name: Anchor Smash
tidehunter_anchor_smash.description: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %radius% units.
tidehunter_anchor_smash.lore: Stolen from one of Admiral Kunkka's flagships, Leviathan's heavy anchor proves useful as a melee weapon.
tidehunter_anchor_smash.note0: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
tidehunter_anchor_smash.note1: Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

tidehunter_ravage.name: Ravage
tidehunter_ravage.description: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
tidehunter_ravage.lore: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.
tidehunter_ravage.note1: Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.

skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.name: Shield of the Scion
skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.description: Dealing magical damage with an ability grants the owner a small magical damage barrier. Effects stack, but their durations are independent.
skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.lore: The court mages of Skywrath may use their powers only to protect the kingdom and the throne.

skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.description: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.lore: Within the Ghastly Eyrie's endless intrigue, only the clever and calm can hope to survive.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.note0: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.shard_description: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.name: Concussive Shot
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.description: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.lore: Those who serve the court of the Ghastly Eyrie are ever locked in covert war. One must always know where danger lurks nearest.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note0: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note1: Damages creeps around the impact area.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.note2: Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.scepter_description: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.name: Ancient Seal
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.description: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.lore: A holy incantation, whosoever finds themselves touched by Avilliva's sigil must suffer in penitent silence.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.note0: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.scepter_description: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.shard_description: Ancient Seal debuff now causes other debuffs applied to last 50%% longer. Grants vision over the target.

skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.name: Mystic Flare
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.description: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.lore: Only the most practiced of Skywrath sorcerers could hope to shape the skies into such a storm.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note0: Spell immune enemies do not count toward the damage distribution.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note1: Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note2: Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.note3: Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.scepter_description: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within %scepter_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

pudge_innate_graft_flesh.name: Flesh Heap
pudge_innate_graft_flesh.description: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining %flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount% bonus Strength for each stack.
pudge_innate_graft_flesh.note0: Enemy Heroes that die within %flesh_heap_range% of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.

pudge_meat_hook.name: Meat Hook
pudge_meat_hook.description: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
pudge_meat_hook.shard_description:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
pudge_meat_hook.facet_pudge_flayers_hook: Meat Hook deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled, but base damage is reduced.
pudge_meat_hook.lore: The Butcher's hook is a symbolic nightmare, its curved blade a frightening reminder of his slaughterous intent.
pudge_meat_hook.note0: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
pudge_meat_hook.note1: Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
pudge_meat_hook.note2: Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
pudge_meat_hook.note3: Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
pudge_meat_hook.note4: Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.

pudge_rot.name: Rot
pudge_rot.description: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
pudge_rot.scepter_description: Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.
pudge_rot.lore: A foul odor precedes a toxic, choking gas, emanating from the Butcher's putrid, ever-swelling mass.
pudge_rot.note1: If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
pudge_rot.bomb_description: The hero throws a gob of stench that applies Rot at the target location.
pudge_rot.bomb_lore: I'm like a shawarma - if you're not lucky, you'll suffer.

pudge_flesh_heap.name: Meat Shield
pudge_flesh_heap.description: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.
pudge_flesh_heap.lore: The Butcher gives new meaning to the words 'meat shield.'

pudge_dismember.name: Dismember
pudge_dismember.description: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
pudge_dismember.facet_pudge_fresh_meat: Dismember increases Strength when dealing damage to heroes.
pudge_dismember.lore: 'When I'm through with these vermin, they'll be fit for a pie!'
pudge_dismember.note0: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.

bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter.name: Big Game Hunter
bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter.description: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.name: Shuriken Toss
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.description: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.scepter_description: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.lore: While the shuriken may be small, Gondar's precise aim can cause critical damage.

bounty_hunter_jinada.name: Jinada
bounty_hunter_jinada.description: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.
bounty_hunter_jinada.lore: Gondar's vast experience ensures he never walks away from a transaction empty-handed.

bounty_hunter_wind_walk.name: Shadow Walk
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.description: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.lore: The court jesters present during King Goff's assassination can recount no other image than a dancing shadow.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.note0: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.ally_description: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.
bounty_hunter_wind_walk.ally_lore: Useful for the rare instances when a contested bounty is actually wanted alive.

bounty_hunter_track.name: Track
bounty_hunter_track.description: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
bounty_hunter_track.lore: Using his elevated senses of sight and smell, Gondar's hits have quite a good chance of success.
bounty_hunter_track.note0: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
bounty_hunter_track.note1: Track's effect is only visible to allies.
bounty_hunter_track.note2: You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.

nature's_prophet_spirit_of_the_forest.name: Spirit of the Forest
nature's_prophet_spirit_of_the_forest.description: Nature's Prophet gains %damage_per_tree_pct%%% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values and with larger radius. Treants also possess this ability.
nature's_prophet_spirit_of_the_forest.note0: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
nature's_prophet_spirit_of_the_forest.note1: Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.

nature's_prophet_sprout.name: Sprout
nature's_prophet_sprout.description: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
nature's_prophet_sprout.lore: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note0: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note1: Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
nature's_prophet_sprout.note2: A Tango that consumes a tree created by Sprout provides double the heal duration.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_description: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, trapping it in place, and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_lore: Verdant overgrowth is a common ailment reported by Nature's Prophet's attackers.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note0: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note1: Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
nature's_prophet_sprout.charges_note2: A Tango that consumes a tree created by Sprout provides double the heal duration.

nature's_prophet_teleportation.name: Teleportation
nature's_prophet_teleportation.description: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.lore: The Prophet keeps his sentinel over the forest, protecting it when in need.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.note0: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
nature's_prophet_teleportation.note1: When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.name: Nature's Call
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.description: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.lore: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.
nature's_prophet_force_of_nature.note0: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.

nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.name: Wrath of Nature
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.description: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after %max_targets% are hit. Search Radius: %radius%
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.lore: Nature's Prophet calls Verodicia's fury to strike down those who might ravage the wilderness.
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.note0: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
nature's_prophet_wrath_of_nature.note1: Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.

phantom_assassin_blur.name: Blur
phantom_assassin_blur.description: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
phantom_assassin_blur.shard_description: Decreases Cooldown. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.
phantom_assassin_blur.abilitydraft_note: With Scepter, only non-ultimate spells will refresh.
phantom_assassin_blur.lore: Meditation allows the Veil Sisters to outpace their foes in battle.
phantom_assassin_blur.note0: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.

phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.name: Stifling Dagger
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.description: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.note0: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.note1: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.note2: Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.
phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.lore: The first skill learned by the Sisters of the Veil often signals an incoming hit.

phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.name: Phantom Strike
phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.description: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.
phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.lore: Mortred's silken veil is the last thing her unfortunate target sees.

phantom_assassin_blur.name: Blur
phantom_assassin_blur.description: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
phantom_assassin_blur.shard_description: Decreases Cooldown. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.
phantom_assassin_blur.abilitydraft_note: With Scepter, only non-ultimate spells will refresh.
phantom_assassin_blur.lore: Meditation allows the Veil Sisters to outpace their foes in battle.
phantom_assassin_blur.note0: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.

phantom_assassin_immaterial.name: Immaterial
phantom_assassin_immaterial.description: Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks. Evasion improves with Phantom Assassin's levels. \n\nStacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.name: Coup de Grace
phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.facet_phantom_assassin_methodical: Coup de Grace procs every %attacks_to_proc% attacks on the same hero or %attacks_to_proc_creeps% attacks on non hero units. Stifling Dagger counts as %two_tooltip% attacks.
phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.description: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.lore: A divine strike, Mortred honors her opponent by choosing them for death.

doom_lvl_pain.name: Lvl ? Pain
doom_lvl_pain.description: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After %damage_debuff_duration%s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a %spread_radius% AoE for %bonus_damage_pct_base%%% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is %bonus_at_level_pct%%% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of %level_multiplier%.
doom_lvl_pain.note0: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.

doom_devour.name: Devour
doom_devour.description: Devours an enemy or neutral creep. The effect lasts as long as the ability's cooldown, and when it ends, the hero gains bonus gold.
doom_devour.lore: Lucifer's appetite and greed are never sated.
doom_devour.note0: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.

doom_scorched_earth.name: Scorched Earth
doom_scorched_earth.description: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
doom_scorched_earth.lore: The Fallen One spreads destruction in his wake, sparing none from the flame which sustains him.
doom_scorched_earth.note0: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

doom_infernal_blade.name: Infernal Blade
doom_infernal_blade.description: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for %ministun_duration% seconds and applies a %burn_duration% second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
doom_infernal_blade.lore: Lucifer shares the fire branding bestowed upon him at the time of his exile.

doom_doom.name: Doom
doom_doom.description: Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
doom_doom.lore: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, doom is sure to follow.

death_prophet_witchcraft.name: Witchcraft
death_prophet_witchcraft.description: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.

death_prophet_carrion_swarm.name: Crypt Swarm
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.description: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.lore: Krobelus' many trips to the grave gather a flock of the damned.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.note0: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

death_prophet_silence.name: Silence
death_prophet_silence.description: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
death_prophet_silence.lore: Peering into the veil of her opponent's demise, Krobelus sees a silent future.

death_prophet_spirit_siphon.name: Spirit Siphon
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.description: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.shard_description: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by %shard_bonus_charges% and causes enemies to be feared for %shard_fear_duration% seconds if they are siphoned for %shard_consecutive_siphon_duration% seconds consecutively.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.note0: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.lore: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.2_description: The hero creates a mystical link with the enemy creature, transferring its health to himself.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.2_note0: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.2_lore: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.3_description: The hero creates a mystical link with the enemy creature, transferring its health to himself.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.3_note0: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.3_lore: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.

death_prophet_exorcism.name: Exorcism
death_prophet_exorcism.description: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
death_prophet_exorcism.scepter_description: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.
death_prophet_exorcism.lore: Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.
death_prophet_exorcism.note0: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
death_prophet_exorcism.note1: Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.

undying_ceaseless_dirge.name: Ceaseless Dirge
undying_ceaseless_dirge.description: Upon death, the hero instantly resurrects. At the start of the game, this ability is on cooldown. The cooldown of this ability cannot be reset and is fixed.
undying_ceaseless_dirge.lore: Only when the Dirge of the Dead God ceases will this soldier's march finally end.

undying_decay.name: Decay
undying_decay.description: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
undying_decay.lore: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.
undying_decay.note0: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
undying_decay.note1: The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.

undying_soul_rip.name: Soul Rip
undying_soul_rip.description: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
undying_soul_rip.facet_undying_ripped: Casting Soul Rip on allies increases their Strength by a percentage of Undying's Strength.
undying_soul_rip.lore: Even allies feel despair in Undying's presence.
undying_soul_rip.note0: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
undying_soul_rip.note1: Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
undying_soul_rip.note2: Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.

undying_tombstone.name: Tombstone
undying_tombstone.description: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
undying_tombstone.lore: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.
undying_tombstone.note0: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
undying_tombstone.note1: Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
undying_tombstone.note2: If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.
undying_tombstone.zombie_deathstrike_description: Slows enemy units on attack.  If the attacked unit's health goes below the threshold, the zombie receives enhanced movement and attack speed.
undying_tombstone.shard_description: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.
undying_tombstone.body_description: Periodically summons a zombie near each enemy in the area of effect. First of all, the heroes.
undying_tombstone.body_lore: In the name of the Scourge!
undying_tombstone.2_description: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
undying_tombstone.2_lore: Dirge calls on his fallen brothers to fight for the Dead God.
undying_tombstone.2_note0: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
undying_tombstone.2_note1: Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
undying_tombstone.2_note2: If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.

undying_flesh_golem.name: Flesh Golem
undying_flesh_golem.description: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
undying_flesh_golem.facet_undying_rotting_mitts: While transformed into a Flesh Golem, attacks spawn a zombie.

invoker_invoke.name: Invoke
invoker_invoke.description:
The hero combines the elements of the active orbs to create a new spell. Cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% sec. for each orb level. Grants an additional ability point at levels %first_ability_level%, %second_ability_level% and %third_ability_level%.

Press the list button to view all available spells.
invoker_invoke.lore: So begins a new age of knowledge.
invoker_invoke.note0: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
invoker_invoke.note1: Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
invoker_invoke.note2: Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

invoker_quas.name: Quas
invoker_quas.description: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
invoker_quas.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
invoker_quas.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
invoker_quas.facet_invoker_quas_focus: <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional level.

invoker_wex.name: Wex
invoker_wex.description: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
invoker_wex.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
invoker_wex.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
invoker_wex.facet_invoker_wex_focus: <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional level.

invoker_exort.name: Exort
invoker_exort.description: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_exort.note0: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
invoker_exort.note1: Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
invoker_exort.facet_invoker_exort_focus: <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional level.

invoker_cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
invoker_cold_snap.description: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
invoker_cold_snap.note0: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.
invoker_cold_snap.facet_invoker_quas_focus: When Cold Snap triggers, Invoker is healed %freeze_heal% hp and restores %freeze_mana% mana.
invoker_cold_snap.ad_description: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases as the level goes up.
invoker_cold_snap.ad_note0: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

invoker_ghost_walk.name: Ghost Walk
invoker_ghost_walk.description: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body transparent. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, and speeds up Invoker as well based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Can be dispelled. The ability is not interrupted by the hero's attacks or spells.
invoker_ghost_walk.note0: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.
invoker_ghost_walk.shard_description: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemies in a larger radius.
invoker_ghost_walk.ad_description: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies, and slows Invoker as well based on the level.
invoker_ghost_walk.ad_note0: The slow effect does not work on Debuff Immune enemies.

invoker_tornado.name: Tornado
invoker_tornado.description: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
invoker_tornado.note0: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
invoker_tornado.scepter_description: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, dealing damage based on <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)
invoker_tornado.ad_description: Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level and holds enemies in the air for a duration.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
invoker_tornado.ad_note0: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

invoker_emp.ty1_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.
invoker_emp.ty2_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.
invoker_emp.name: E.M.P.
invoker_emp.description: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
invoker_emp.facet_invoker_wex_focus: E.M.P. deals its damage again to all barriers.
invoker_emp.shard_description: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.
invoker_emp.note0: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
invoker_emp.ad_description: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
invoker_emp.ad_note0: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
invoker_emp.ad_shard_description: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %shard_drag_speed% units per second.
invoker_emp.ty1_custom_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.
invoker_emp.ty2_custom_description: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.

invoker_alacrity.name: Alacrity
invoker_alacrity.description: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> and their damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_alacrity.facet_invoker_wex_focus: Alacrity grants bonus attack range when used on Invoker or any ranged units under his control.
invoker_alacrity.ad_description: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed and their damage.

invoker_chaos_meteor.name: Chaos Meteor
invoker_chaos_meteor.description: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, and rolling further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_chaos_meteor.facet_invoker_exort_focus: Chaos Meteor has %bonus_area_of_effect% bonus radius and %bonus_travel_distance% bonus travel distance.
invoker_chaos_meteor.note0: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
invoker_chaos_meteor.note1: The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.
invoker_chaos_meteor.ad_description: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage and rolling further based on the level. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time.
invoker_chaos_meteor.ad_note0: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
invoker_chaos_meteor.ad_note1: The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.

invoker_sun_strike.name: Sun Strike
invoker_sun_strike.description: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
invoker_sun_strike.scepter_description: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
invoker_sun_strike.shard_description: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
invoker_sun_strike.note0: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
invoker_sun_strike.note1: Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
invoker_sun_strike.ad_description: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
invoker_sun_strike.ad_note0: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
invoker_sun_strike.ad_note1: Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
invoker_sun_strike.ad_scepter_description: Adds Cataclysm. Launched when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.

invoker_forge_spirit.name: Forge Spirit
invoker_forge_spirit.description: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. Spawns two spirits when Quas and Exort are at least level 4.
invoker_forge_spirit.note0: Summoning new spirits will destroy the old ones.
invoker_forge_spirit.ad_description: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.
invoker_forge_spirit.ad_note0: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

invoker_ice_wall.name: Ice Wall
invoker_ice_wall.description: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and deals damage each second based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_ice_wall.scepter_description: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
invoker_ice_wall.ad_description: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies and deals damage each second.
invoker_ice_wall.ad_note0: The slow will still affect Debuff Immune enemies if their debuff immunity was created after being affected by Ice Wall.
invoker_ice_wall.note0: The slow will still affect Spell Immune enemies if their spell immunity was created after being affected by Ice Wall.

invoker_deafening_blast.name: Deafening Blast
invoker_deafening_blast.description: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
invoker_deafening_blast.ad_description: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration then disarm their attacks for a duration.
