terrorblade_dark_unity.description: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.

terrorblade_reflection.name: Reflection
terrorblade_reflection.description: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
terrorblade_reflection.lore: In the fractal prison of Foulfell, Terrorblade learned the truth of this old tale: you are your own worst enemy.  Now it is a lesson he teaches others.
terrorblade_reflection.note0: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
terrorblade_reflection.note1: Reflections can only attack their source.

terrorblade_conjure_image.name: Conjure Image
terrorblade_conjure_image.description: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
terrorblade_conjure_image.facet_terrorblade_soul_fragment: Conjure Image illusions always spawn at full health and cost health instead of mana.
terrorblade_conjure_image.lore: There's only one thing more dangerous than facing Terrorblade. Facing MORE Terrorblades!
terrorblade_conjure_image.note0: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.

terrorblade_metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
terrorblade_metamorphosis.description: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within %metamorph_aura_tooltip% range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
terrorblade_metamorphosis.lore: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control. Meet Terrorblade's own worst self.
terrorblade_metamorphosis.note0: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.

terrorblade_sunder.name: Sunder
terrorblade_sunder.description: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
terrorblade_sunder.facet_terrorblade_condemned: There is no minimum health threshold for Sundered enemies.
terrorblade_sunder.note0: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.
terrorblade_sunder.lore: You didn't need that life, did you?  The demon marauder steals that which you hold most dear.

vengeful_spirit_retribution.name: Retribution
vengeful_spirit_retribution.description:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals %bonus_damage%%% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

vengeful_spirit_magic_missile.name: Magic Missile
vengeful_spirit_magic_missile.description: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
vengeful_spirit_magic_missile.lore: A simple Skywrath technique, the magic missile is Shendel's primary tool for vengeance.

vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror.name: Wave of Terror
vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror.description: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror.lore: Shendel's haunting voice hints at her approaching vindication.

vengeful_spirit_command_aura.name: Vengeance Aura
vengeful_spirit_command_aura.description: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
vengeful_spirit_command_aura.lore: Although they may not share her undying passion for revenge, allies do draw on her fanaticism in combat.

vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.name: Nether Swap
vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.description: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.lore: Martyrdom is a small price to pay for vengeance.
vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.note1: Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
vengeful_spirit_nether_swap.note2: Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

muerta_supernatural.name: Supernatural
muerta_supernatural.description: Whenever an enemy hero dies within %stack_collection_range% units of Muerta, she gains a stack of %spell_amp_per_stack%%% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.

muerta_dead_shot.name: DEAD SHOT
muerta_dead_shot.description:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
muerta_dead_shot.facet_muerta_slingshot: Dead Shot fears increase Gunslinger chance to %gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%x for %gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%s.
muerta_dead_shot.scepter_description: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
muerta_dead_shot.note0: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
muerta_dead_shot.note1: The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
muerta_dead_shot.note2: Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
muerta_dead_shot.lore: A steady gunhand and an eternity of practice produce trickshots that defy the mortal mind.

muerta_the_calling.name: THE CALLING
muerta_the_calling.lore: Muerta's family are forever beyond the spirit veil, but her deal with Death allows her to briefly call on them in times of want or need.
muerta_the_calling.description: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
muerta_the_calling.facet_muerta_dance_of_the_dead: Heroes killed inside The Calling refresh its duration, create another Revenant, and expand the radius of The Calling by %kill_radius_expansion%.

muerta_gunslinger.name: GUNSLINGER
muerta_gunslinger.description: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
muerta_gunslinger.facet_muerta_slingshot: Gunslinger procs reduce Dead Shot cooldown by %dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%s.
muerta_gunslinger.note0: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
muerta_gunslinger.note1: Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus %target_search_bonus_range%.
muerta_gunslinger.note2: The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
muerta_gunslinger.note3: Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.
muerta_gunslinger.lore: Muerta offers all of her victims Mercy. Some are fortunate enough to also earn Grace.

muerta_pierce_the_veil.name: PIERCE THE VEIL
muerta_pierce_the_veil.description:
Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
muerta_pierce_the_veil.lore: Muerta sheds her corporeal form, crossing the spirit veil and striking her enemies with the fury of the damned.
muerta_pierce_the_veil.shard_description:
Muerta gains %spell_lifesteal%%% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.
While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains %spell_amp_steal%%% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.
muerta_pierce_the_veil.note0: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
muerta_pierce_the_veil.note1: Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.

legion_commander_outfight_them.name: Outfight Them!
legion_commander_outfight_them.description: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within %radius% range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for %duration%s; allies gain %ally_factor%%% of the value.  This bonus stacks independently.

legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.name: Overwhelming Odds
legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.description: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a %movement_slow%%% impact slow for %slow_duration%s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.shard_description: Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.
legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.lore: The archers of Stonehall are ready at Tresdin's command.

legion_commander_press_the_attack.name: Press The Attack
legion_commander_press_the_attack.description: Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
legion_commander_press_the_attack.lore: The rallying horn of the Bronze Legion is able to inspire any heart.
legion_commander_press_the_attack.scepter_description: Increases movement speed and becomes an %radius% area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.

legion_commander_moment_of_courage.name: Moment of Courage
legion_commander_moment_of_courage.description: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
legion_commander_moment_of_courage.lore: Tresdin knows that an enemy's most vulnerable moment often follows their fiercest stroke.
legion_commander_moment_of_courage.note0: The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.

legion_commander_duel.name: Duel
legion_commander_duel.description: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
legion_commander_duel.scepter_description: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.
legion_commander_duel.note0: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
legion_commander_duel.lore: To face a soldier of Stonehall in single combat is a challenge few can resist.
legion_commander_duel.note1: Winning a Duel automatically casts Press the Attack on yourself.

lion_to_hell_and_back.name: To Hell and Back
lion_to_hell_and_back.description:
Lion gains %debuff_amp%%% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains %spell_amp%%% spell amplification for %duration%s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

lion_impale.name: Earth Spike
lion_impale.description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
lion_impale.lore: The Demon Witch exercises his demonic covenant, opening a fissure from hell.
lion_impale.note0: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
lion_impale.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

lion_voodoo.name: Hex
lion_voodoo.description: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
lion_voodoo.lore: Lion is compelled to share his transfiguration, twisting the essence of those who oppose him.
lion_voodoo.note1: The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

lion_mana_drain.name: Mana Drain
lion_mana_drain.description:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%. 

 Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
lion_mana_drain.facet_lion_essence_eater: Mana Drain deals damage equal to %damage_pct%%% of mana stolen.
lion_mana_drain.shard_description: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
lion_mana_drain.lore: Lesser magi are nothing more than a source of magical restoration for the Demon Witch.
lion_mana_drain.note0: Instantly destroys illusions and prevents heroes from going invisible.

lion_finger_of_death.name: Finger of Death
lion_finger_of_death.description:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. 

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
lion_finger_of_death.scepter_description: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.
lion_finger_of_death.lore: Lion's disfigured hand is also the source of his greatest power, capable of flooding victims with malefic force.
lion_finger_of_death.note0: Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
lion_finger_of_death.note1: Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.

kunkka_admirals_rum.name: Admiral's Rum
kunkka_admirals_rum.description: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
kunkka_admirals_rum.lore: Deleterious to landlubbers, no one holds their rum like a sailor.
kunkka_admirals_rum.note0: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

kunkka_torrent.name: Torrent
kunkka_torrent.description: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
kunkka_torrent.lore: An ancestral rush of water explodes from the center of the world, called upon by the Admiral.
kunkka_torrent.note0: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
kunkka_torrent.note1: Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.
kunkka_torrent.storm_custom_description: Releases a visible Torrent in a random area around Kunkka once every %torrent_interval% for %torrent_duration% seconds. Spawns within %torrent_max_distance% range of him.
kunkka_torrent.storm_custom_lore: A hundred leagues of dry land couldn't keep these seas at bay.

kunkka_tidebringer.name: Tidebringer
kunkka_tidebringer.description: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
kunkka_tidebringer.facet_kunkka_high_tide: Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.
kunkka_tidebringer.lore: A lost Claddish soul inhabits Kunkka's trusty Tidebringer, empowering it to destroy demons of the Cataract.

kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.name: X Marks the Spot
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.facet_kunkka_grog: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.description: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.lore: The Admiral's set of arcane abilities includes some that can be used for battle as well as entertainment.
kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.note0: If the target becomes Spell Immune after the cast, the target will not return to the X after the duration.

kunkka_ghostship.name: Ghostship
kunkka_ghostship.description:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
kunkka_ghostship.lore: The final ship of the Claddish Navy is nothing but a phantom, but it is all too real to the enemies of the Admiral.
kunkka_ghostship.scepter_description: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
kunkka_ghostship.note0: The impact area of the shipwreck is larger than the ship itself.
kunkka_ghostship.note1: The ship moves at a speed of %ghostship_speed%.

slardar_seaborn_sentinel.name: Seaborn Sentinel
slardar_seaborn_sentinel.description: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
slardar_seaborn_sentinel.scepter_description: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by %scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%% and puddle/trail duration by %scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%s.

slardar_sprint.name: Guardian Sprint
slardar_sprint.description: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
slardar_sprint.facet_slardar_leg_day: Slardar has slow resistance and even more movement speed at the beginning of Guardian Sprint.
slardar_sprint.lore: As Slardar has made the transition from the Deeps, it has been necessary to use his powerful tail for sprinting instead of swimming.
slardar_sprint.note0: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.

slardar_slithereen_crush.name: Slithereen Crush
slardar_slithereen_crush.description: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
slardar_slithereen_crush.scepter_description: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.
slardar_slithereen_crush.shard_description: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
slardar_slithereen_crush.lore: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.
slardar_slithereen_crush.2_description: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
slardar_slithereen_crush.2_lore: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.
slardar_slithereen_crush.3_description: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
slardar_slithereen_crush.3_lore: A swift crush of might and water breaks even the toughest of defenses.

slardar_bash.name: Bash of the Deep
slardar_bash.description: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
slardar_bash.lore: Thieves of the wealth of the Deep Ones meet the brutality of the Slithereen Guard in melee combat.
slardar_bash.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
slardar_bash.abilitydraft_note: In Ability Draft, does stack with Skull Basher.

slardar_amplify_damage.name: Corrosive Haze
slardar_amplify_damage.description: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
slardar_amplify_damage.facet_slardar_brineguard: Corrosive Haze increases Slardar's armor by %armor_pct%%% of the total armor reduced.
slardar_amplify_damage.lore: Even the strongest armor counts for little when left to the brine of the sea.

morphling_ebb_and_flow.name: Ebb and Flow
morphling_ebb_and_flow.description: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
morphling_ebb_and_flow.note0: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

morphling_waveform.name: Waveform
morphling_waveform.description: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
morphling_waveform.lore: A torrential flood takes enemies by force.
morphling_waveform.facet_morphling_agi: Waveform attacks enemies in his path. Does not apply on-hit effects.
morphling_waveform.reverse_custom_description: This ability can be cast within %delay% seconds of Waveform to return to its original position.

morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.name: Adaptive Strike
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.description: Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.\n\nKnockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.facet_morphling_str: Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength.
morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.lore: The Morphling calls upon his elements to crush his opponents with waves.

morphling_morph_agi.name: Attribute Shift (Agility Gain)
morphling_morph_agi.description: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
morphling_morph_agi.shard_description: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
morphling_morph_agi.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
morphling_morph_agi.note0: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
morphling_morph_agi.note1: Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.

morphling_morph_str.name: Attribute Shift (Strength Gain)
morphling_morph_str.description: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
morphling_morph_str.shard_description: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
morphling_morph_str.lore: Shifting water makes it difficult to discern the nature of Morphling.
morphling_morph_str.note0: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
morphling_morph_str.note1: Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.

morphling_replicate.name: Morph
morphling_replicate.description: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
morphling_replicate.scepter_description: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.
morphling_replicate.lore: Staring into Morphling produces a reflection that mimics the beholder.
morphling_replicate.note0: You can't target yourself with Morph.
morphling_replicate.note1: Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.

slark_essence_shift.name: Essence Shift
slark_essence_shift.description: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %agi_gain% Agility.
slark_essence_shift.lore: With each strike at his adversaries, Slark's knowledge of their weaknesses improves.
slark_essence_shift.note0: To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within 300 range of Slark while having the Essence Shift debuff.
slark_essence_shift.note1: Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
slark_essence_shift.note2: To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
slark_essence_shift.note3: Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
slark_essence_shift.note4: Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.

slark_dark_pact.name: Dark Pact
slark_dark_pact.description: After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
slark_dark_pact.lore: Slithereen are capable of quickly regrowing appendages, in case of critical injury, to save their own lives.
slark_dark_pact.note0: %delay% seconds after cast, a series of %total_pulses% pulses separated by %pulse_interval% seconds deal the damage.
slark_dark_pact.note1: Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
slark_dark_pact.note2: You can't kill yourself with this skill.
slark_dark_pact.note3: The pulses stop if Slark dies.

slark_pounce.name: Pounce
slark_pounce.description: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
slark_pounce.facet_slark_leeching_leash: Pounce applies stacks of Essence Shift when striking enemy heroes.
slark_pounce.lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.
slark_pounce.note0: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
slark_pounce.note1: Spell Immune units cannot be leashed.
slark_pounce.note2: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.
slark_pounce.2_description: Slark leaps forward, leashing the first hero he connects.  That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
slark_pounce.2_lore: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.
slark_pounce.2_note0: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
slark_pounce.2_note1: Spell Immune units cannot be leashed.
slark_pounce.2_note2: Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.

slark_saltwater_shiv.name: Saltwater Shiv
slark_saltwater_shiv.description:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

slark_shadow_dance.name: Shadow Dance
slark_shadow_dance.description:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.  If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.
slark_shadow_dance.lore: The hidden Thirteenth is a slippery foe.
slark_shadow_dance.note0: If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.
slark_shadow_dance.note1: The passive movement and health regeneration bonuses have a %activation_delay% second activation and deactivation delay.

oracle_prognosticate.description: The hero is able to see and reveal the location of all active runes on the map to allies.

oracle_fortunes_end.name: Fortune's End
oracle_fortunes_end.description: CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
oracle_fortunes_end.lore: The astral orb crackles with power while raw energy lances out, temporarily disrupting an enemy's connection to their own body.
oracle_fortunes_end.note0: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

oracle_fates_edict.name: Fate's Edict
oracle_fates_edict.description: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them %magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%% magic damage resistance.
oracle_fates_edict.lore: An unbreakable prophecy resounds: a chosen ally shall briefly suffer no magics. Other kinds of suffering however...

oracle_purifying_flames.name: Purifying Flames
oracle_purifying_flames.description: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
oracle_purifying_flames.lore: Like a hall of mirrors might amplify the light of a single candle, the shattered walls of the universe can transform the light of prophecy into a burning torch.
oracle_purifying_flames.note0: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
oracle_purifying_flames.note1: The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.

oracle_false_promise.name: False Promise
oracle_false_promise.description: Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
oracle_false_promise.lore: Foes and false prophets oft make lies of men's fates.
oracle_false_promise.note0: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
oracle_false_promise.note1: The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.

disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion.description: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion.lore: Safe harbor found inside the storm.
disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion.note0: After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.

disruptor_thunder_strike.name: Thunder Strike
disruptor_thunder_strike.description: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
disruptor_thunder_strike.facet_disruptor_thunderstorm: Thunder Strike additionally hits all enemies within Kinetic Field. Thunder Strike Slow duration is increased to %slow_duration%s.
disruptor_thunder_strike.shard_description: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.
disruptor_thunder_strike.lore: Disruptor's charged coils occasionally overload, and a singed armor plate or tuft of fur is the enemy's result.

disruptor_glimpse.name: Glimpse
disruptor_glimpse.description: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
disruptor_glimpse.lore: Playing with electricity can have unexpected results.
disruptor_glimpse.note0: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

disruptor_kinetic_field.name: Kinetic Field
disruptor_kinetic_field.description: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
disruptor_kinetic_field.lore: The stryder is immune to the gale-force winds that will consume its adversaries.
disruptor_kinetic_field.note0: Spell Immune units can travel through the field.
disruptor_kinetic_field.shard_description: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

disruptor_static_storm.name: Static Storm
disruptor_static_storm.description: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
disruptor_static_storm.lore: A summer squall in Druud is a hardship that only an Oglodi can survive.

juggernaut_bladeform.name: Bladeform
juggernaut_bladeform.description: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every %stack_gain_time%s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.
juggernaut_bladeform.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
juggernaut_bladeform.note1: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

juggernaut_blade_fury.name: Blade Fury
juggernaut_blade_fury.description: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
juggernaut_blade_fury.scepter_description:
Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect.

Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every %attack_interval%s.
juggernaut_blade_fury.lore: Yurnero's renowned katana techniques are feared by warriors and sorcerors alike.
juggernaut_blade_fury.note0: You can use items during Blade Fury.
juggernaut_blade_fury.note1: Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.

juggernaut_healing_ward.name: Healing Ward
juggernaut_healing_ward.description: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %duration% seconds.
juggernaut_healing_ward.lore: Of the rituals learned at the Isle of Masks, tending wounds with a bit of voodoo magic has proven to be quite useful.
juggernaut_healing_ward.note0: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
juggernaut_healing_ward.note1: Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.

juggernaut_blade_dance.name: Blade Dance
juggernaut_blade_dance.description: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.
juggernaut_blade_dance.lore: The last remnant of his heritage's commitment to bladework, Yurnero ensures that the style is remembered.

juggernaut_omni_slash.name: Omnislash
juggernaut_omni_slash.description: Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
juggernaut_omni_slash.lore: The fruits of discipline; with practice comes strength.
juggernaut_omni_slash.note0: You can use items during Omnislash.

spectre_desolate.name: Desolate
spectre_desolate.description: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
spectre_desolate.facet_spectre_forsaken: Spectre deals %bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%x damage with Desolate. Spectre's illusions no longer have Desolate.
spectre_desolate.lore: Often times, warriors find themselves alone with a vision of Mercurial - the fated question is if it is the true Spectre.
spectre_desolate.note0: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.

spectre_spectral_dagger.name: Spectral Dagger
spectre_spectral_dagger.description: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
spectre_spectral_dagger.facet_spectre_forsaken: Spectral Dagger applies an instance of Desolate.
spectre_spectral_dagger.lore: Mercurial's dagger eclipses the physical plane in shadow, a state in which mortals cower, but spectres thrive.
spectre_spectral_dagger.note0: There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
spectre_spectral_dagger.note1: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

spectre_desolate.name: Desolate
spectre_desolate.description: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
spectre_desolate.facet_spectre_forsaken: Spectre deals %bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%x damage with Desolate. Spectre's illusions no longer have Desolate.
spectre_desolate.lore: Often times, warriors find themselves alone with a vision of Mercurial - the fated question is if it is the true Spectre.
spectre_desolate.note0: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.

spectre_dispersion.name: Dispersion
spectre_dispersion.description: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
spectre_dispersion.lore: A daunting task lies before enemies of Mercurial - killing a shadow with blade and magic.
spectre_dispersion.note0: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
spectre_dispersion.note2: Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
spectre_dispersion.note3: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
spectre_dispersion.shard_description: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by %activation_bonus_pct%%% of its base values for %activation_duration%s. Cooldown %activation_cooldown%. Manacost %activation_manacost%.

spectre_reality.name: Reality
spectre_reality.description: Spectre assumes the target Shadow Step or Haunt illusion, destroying it.
spectre_reality.lore: The scattered shadows unite into the one true Spectre.
spectre_reality.shard_description: Reality also casts Spectral Dagger on the illusion's target.

spectre_haunt.name: Haunt
spectre_haunt.description:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.  They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it. Search Radius: %radius%
spectre_haunt.lore: At the height of combat, Mercurial's physical manifestation shatters, and the shadowy pieces haunt those who still cling to life.
spectre_haunt.scepter_description:
The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.

Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.

bristleback_prickly.name: Prickly
bristleback_prickly.description: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.description: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.facet_bristleback_snot_rocket: Max stacks and armor reduction per stack increased.
bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.lore: Having caught a cold while stuck in the snow, Bristleback turns it to his advantage.

bristleback_quill_spray.name: Quill Spray
bristleback_quill_spray.abilitydraft_note:
Shard: Access Hairball by toggling auto-cast on Quill Spray.

Must draft Nasal Goo for it to work with Hairball.
bristleback_quill_spray.description: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
bristleback_quill_spray.lore: An enforcer's honor can be a prickly thing.  So can his quills.
bristleback_quill_spray.note0: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

bristleback_bristleback.name: Bristleback
bristleback_bristleback.abilitydraft_note: Quill Spray must be drafted also to release when damage threshold reached.
bristleback_bristleback.description: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
bristleback_bristleback.facet_bristleback_snot_rocket: Instead of releasing Quill Spray from taking damage, he instead launches Nasal Goo of the current level at all nearby enemies.
bristleback_bristleback.lore: Turning his back to a fight might be just the thing.
bristleback_bristleback.note0: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
bristleback_bristleback.note1: Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
bristleback_bristleback.note2: Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
bristleback_bristleback.scepter_description: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.

bristleback_warpath.name: Warpath
bristleback_warpath.description: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
bristleback_warpath.facet_bristleback_berserk: Warpath grants scaling Attack Speed instead of Damage.
bristleback_warpath.lore: 'Temper, temper,' his mum always chided.  But in a fight, a temper can come in handy.
bristleback_warpath.note0: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
bristleback_warpath.note2: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
bristleback_warpath.note3: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
bristleback_warpath.facet_bristleback_seeing_red: Warpath can be activated to grant bonus attack damage and movement speed for a short duration. While Seeing Red, Bristleback's vision is reduced to a narrow cone and he does not receive vision from his allies.

spirit_breaker_bull_rush.name: Empowering Haste
spirit_breaker_bull_rush.description: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
spirit_breaker_bull_rush.note0: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.

spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.name: Charge of Darkness
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.lore: Barathrum erupts from the darkness with unwieldy force.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.description:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.facet_spirit_breaker_bull_rush: Charge of Darkness bonus movement speed lingers after charge ends.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note0: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note1: The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.note2: Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.shard_description: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.abilitydraft_note: No other units will be hit by Greater Bash if it's not drafted as well. Target of Charge of Darkness will be stunned on impact even without Greater Bash.

spirit_breaker_bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
spirit_breaker_bulldoze.description: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
spirit_breaker_bulldoze.lore: Barathrum warps the fabric of reality around him, lessening its influence on his physical form.

spirit_breaker_greater_bash.name: Greater Bash
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.lore: The signature strike of Barathrum's ghostly ball and chain.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.description: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.facet_spirit_breaker_bulls_hit: Greater Bash chance is increased if you've bashed more than one hero within the last %bonus_chance_duration%s. Each additional hero past the first increases Greater Bash chance by %bonus_chance_pct%%%.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.note1: Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.abilitydraft_note: In Ability Draft, does stack with Skull Basher.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.scepter_description: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.

spirit_breaker_nether_strike.name: Nether Strike
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.lore: Barathrum temporarily returns to the realm from where he came, bringing with him the retribution of both worlds.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.description: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.facet_spirit_breaker_imbalanced: Enemy targets hit by Nether Strike will be moved further by allied knockback effects.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.note0: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.
spirit_breaker_nether_strike.abilitydraft_note: Greater Bash must be drafted for stun.  Bonus damage still applies without Greater Bash.

ancient_apparition_bone_chill.name: Bone Chill
ancient_apparition_bone_chill.description: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

ancient_apparition_cold_feet.name: Cold Feet
ancient_apparition_cold_feet.description: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after %AbilityDuration% seconds.
ancient_apparition_cold_feet.facet_ancient_apparition_exposure: Cold Feet becomes an AoE point targeted ability, with the radius depending on the current level of Ice Blast.
ancient_apparition_cold_feet.lore: Kaldr's presence draws those around him into a frozen void, threatening to lock them in an icy prison for eternity.

ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.name: Ice Vortex
ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.description: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.lore: Frozen, caustic winds are at the whim of Kaldr, chilling the field of battle.
ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.note0: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.

ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.name: Chilling Touch
ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.description: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.lore: The Ancient Apparition's eternal knowledge brings a frigid enchantment to his attacks.

ancient_apparition_ice_blast.name: Ice Blast
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.description: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.shard_description: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.lore: Ice storms from ages past flow through Kaldr's frosty limbs, crashing into the world and turning its inhabitants into monuments to his eternal power.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note0: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note1: The area of effect is %radius_min% + %radius_grow%*TimeTraveled, capped at %radius_max%.  The freeze area along the path is %path_radius%.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note2: Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note3: The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.note4: The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.release_description: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location. Can be cast while silenced.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.release_custom_description: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location.

lich_death_charge.name: Sacrifice
lich_death_charge.description: The hero sacrifices an enemy creep, converting its current health into mana for themselves and gaining experience for its kill. Cannot be cast on Ancient creeps.
lich_death_charge.note0: Ancient creeps and creep heroes cannot be sacrificed.
lich_death_charge.note1: Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

lich_frost_nova.name: Frost Blast
lich_frost_nova.description: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.
lich_frost_nova.lore: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.
lich_frost_nova.ring_custom_description: Casts Frost Blast after a short delay in a circle around the hero.
lich_frost_nova.ring_custom_lore: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.
lich_frost_nova.line_custom_description: Casts Frost Blast after a short delay along the line in front of the hero.
lich_frost_nova.line_custom_lore: Frost-mage Ethreain has not forgotten even the simplest of ice manipulation.

lich_frost_shield.name: Frost Shield
lich_frost_shield.description: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
lich_frost_shield.facet_lich_growing_cold: Whenever an enemy dies under the effect of Frost Shield, its duration is increased.
lich_frost_shield.lore: First conceived of to protect him in his mortal years, the frost magic that Ethreain weaves around himself has only grown colder with time.
lich_frost_shield.note0: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
lich_frost_shield.note1: Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.

lich_sinister_gaze.name: Sinister Gaze
lich_sinister_gaze.description: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
lich_sinister_gaze.scepter_description: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

lich_death_charge.name: Sacrifice
lich_death_charge.description: The hero sacrifices an enemy creep, converting its current health into mana for themselves and gaining experience for its kill. Cannot be cast on Ancient creeps.
lich_death_charge.note0: Ancient creeps and creep heroes cannot be sacrificed.
lich_death_charge.note1: Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

lich_chain_frost.name: Chain Frost
lich_chain_frost.description: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
lich_chain_frost.facet_lich_frostbound: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
lich_chain_frost.facet_lich_growing_cold: Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.
lich_chain_frost.lore: Almost universally considered the ultimate in frost magic, Ethreain's orb of frozen death strikes fear into those who dare stand against him.
lich_chain_frost.note1: Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
lich_chain_frost.note2: Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.

aghanim_apex.description: Aghanim gains bonus attributes for each level. If the Moon Aghanim item effect is active, the bonus is doubled.

aghanim_blink_cast.name: Continuum
aghanim_blink_cast.description: Aghanim makes a time jump back. Pulls nearby enemies to the starting point and slows.

aghanim_shard.name: Shard Blast
aghanim_shard.description: Launches a shard in a direction that explodes on impact with an enemy, dealing damage and inflicting a debuff that briefly reduces all outgoing damage.

aghanim_ray.name: Aghanim's Ray
aghanim_ray.description: Aghanim casts a powerful ray with his scepter. Deals magic damage upon hitting an enemy, and if the target's health was below the threshold, the damage will be doubled. Ray can be controlled.

dazzle_innate_weave.name: Weave
dazzle_innate_weave.description: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
dazzle_innate_weave.shard_description: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
dazzle_innate_weave.facet_dazzle_facet_nothl_boon: Weave applies %ally_multiplier%x stacks to allies. Weave amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle by %heal_amplification_pct%%% per stack.
dazzle_innate_weave.lore: His ethereal journey into the Nothl realm has allowed Dazzle to mend together the powers of light and dark, creating shifting waves of enchantments.

dazzle_poison_touch.name: Poison Touch
dazzle_poison_touch.description: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
dazzle_poison_touch.lore: One of the few Dezun rites used for offensive purposes, the paralytic enchantment often proves useful.
dazzle_poison_touch.note0: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.
dazzle_poison_touch.note1: Units afflicted by Poison Touch can be denied when their HP drops below 25%.

dazzle_shallow_grave.name: Shallow Grave
dazzle_shallow_grave.description: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
dazzle_shallow_grave.lore: Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.
dazzle_shallow_grave.note0: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

dazzle_shadow_wave.name: Shadow Wave
dazzle_shadow_wave.description: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
dazzle_shadow_wave.lore: While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.
dazzle_shadow_wave.note1: If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.
dazzle_shadow_wave.scepter_description: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

dazzle_nothl_projection.name: Nothl Projection
dazzle_nothl_projection.description: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
dazzle_nothl_projection.lore: The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.
dazzle_nothl_projection.note0: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
dazzle_nothl_projection.shard_description: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.
dazzle_nothl_projection.end_description: Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.

wraith_king_vampiric_aura.name: Vampiric Spirit
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.description: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note0: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note2: Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note3: Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.

wraith_king_hellfire_blast.name: Wraithfire Blast
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.description: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.lore: Ostarion calls on his damned lineage, laying waste to his opponents.
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.note0: If Wraith King has summoned skeletons, casting Wraithfire Blast on a target will order all of the skeletons to attack that target.

wraith_king_vampiric_aura.name: Vampiric Spirit
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.description: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note0: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note2: Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note3: Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.

wraith_king_mortal_strike.name: Mortal Strike
wraith_king_mortal_strike.description: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
wraith_king_mortal_strike.lore: One blow to crush a foe.

wraith_king_reincarnation.name: Reincarnation
wraith_king_reincarnation.description: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
wraith_king_reincarnation.lore: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.
wraith_king_reincarnation.note0: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
wraith_king_reincarnation.note1: Revives with full HP and Mana.
wraith_king_reincarnation.blink_description: Can be used to move to the target point and instantly refresh the cooldown of Wraithfire Blast.

weaver_threads_of_fate.name: Threads of Fate
weaver_threads_of_fate.description: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within %thread_setup_distance% range of them for %thread_setup_time%s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

weaver_the_swarm.name: The Swarm
weaver_the_swarm.description: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
weaver_the_swarm.facet_weaver_hivemind: Weaver gains experience when The Swarm beetles attack heroes.
weaver_the_swarm.lore: Skitskurr opens a gap in the space time fabric, allowing young Weavers to slip through and aid him in combat.
weaver_the_swarm.note0: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
weaver_the_swarm.note1: Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in %destroy_attacks% attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.

weaver_shukuchi.name: Shukuchi
weaver_shukuchi.description: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
weaver_shukuchi.facet_weaver_skitterstep: Shukuchi movespeed increased and slows enemies when passing through them.
weaver_shukuchi.shard_description: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last %geminate_attack_mark_duration% seconds. %shukuchi_attack_delay%s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within %shukuchi_attack_mark_radius% range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack
weaver_shukuchi.lore: As the Weavers worked in the fabric of creation, small wormholes allowed them to slip through time to better work their craft.
weaver_shukuchi.note0: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.

weaver_geminate_attack.name: Geminate Attack
weaver_geminate_attack.description: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
weaver_geminate_attack.lore: Skitskurr's relationship with time is somewhat variable, causing his actions to be witnessed - and felt - more than once.
weaver_geminate_attack.note0: Additional attacks leave Weaver %delay% seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
weaver_geminate_attack.note1: Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.
weaver_geminate_attack.shard_description: Geminate Attack will also hit units within %shard_beetle_search_range% range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.

weaver_time_lapse.name: Time Lapse
weaver_time_lapse.description: Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
weaver_time_lapse.lore: If Skitskurr does not deem the current reality of the world to fit his desires, he simply crawls back in time to right what was wronged.
weaver_time_lapse.note0: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
weaver_time_lapse.scepter_description: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with %abilitycastrange% cast range.

abaddon_withering_mist.name: Withering Mist
abaddon_withering_mist.description: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for %duration%s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by %heal_reduction_pct%%% if they are below %hp_threshold_pct%%% HP.

abaddon_death_coil.name: Mist Coil
abaddon_death_coil.description: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
abaddon_death_coil.facet_abaddon_mists_of_fate: Mist Coil also deals %damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%% attack damage and applies effects from items and abilities. Self Damage increased when targeting enemies.
abaddon_death_coil.lore: A mysterious vapor from the Font of Avernus now infuses the breath of Abaddon, who releases it at will.
abaddon_death_coil.note0: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.

abaddon_aphotic_shield.name: Aphotic Shield
abaddon_aphotic_shield.description: Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abaddon_aphotic_shield.facet_abaddon_mephitic_shroud: Damage barrier amount increased, but no longer bursts upon expiration. %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies. Increases cooldown.
abaddon_aphotic_shield.shard_description: %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
abaddon_aphotic_shield.lore: The powers of the black mist rise to absorb attacks like the black mist absorbs light.
abaddon_aphotic_shield.note0: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
abaddon_aphotic_shield.note1: The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.

abaddon_frostmourne.name: Curse of Avernus
abaddon_frostmourne.description: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by %tower_dps_pct%%%.
abaddon_frostmourne.lore: While the baptized draw strength from the Font, the gifts of Avernus are debilitating to the uninitiated.

abaddon_borrowed_time.name: Borrowed Time
abaddon_borrowed_time.description: When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below %hp_threshold%.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abaddon_borrowed_time.facet_abaddon_mephitic_shroud: While Borrowed Time is active, Abaddon and enemies within %immolate_aoe% radius take %immolate_damage% damage per second.
abaddon_borrowed_time.lore: The most unnatural of all the gifts of the Font of Avernus, this power defies mortal understanding.  What should hurt, instead heals; and what should kill gives strength anew.
abaddon_borrowed_time.scepter_description: Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than %ally_threshold_scepter% damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.
abaddon_borrowed_time.note0: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced. The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
abaddon_borrowed_time.note1: Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
abaddon_borrowed_time.note2: Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.

medusa_mana_shield.name: Mana Shield
medusa_mana_shield.description: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
medusa_mana_shield.note0: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.
medusa_mana_shield.facet_medusa_mana_pact: Mana Shield can be activated, draining %aspd_increase_mana_cost_pct%%% of max mana per second to gain %aspd_increase_rate_pct%%% attack speed bonus per second, up to %aspd_increase_max_tooltip%%%. Maximum effect reached after %aspd_increase_max_aspd_time%s. Buff lasts %aspd_increase_buff_duration%s and Cooldown is %attack_buff_cooldown%s.
medusa_mana_shield.lore: While Medusa was not gifted with eternal life upon birth, her curse bestowed her with impressive defensive powers.

medusa_split_shot.name: Split Shot
medusa_split_shot.description:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
medusa_split_shot.scepter_description: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.
medusa_split_shot.lore: All who encounter the cursed Gorgon will feel her rage.
medusa_split_shot.note0: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
medusa_split_shot.note1: If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.

medusa_mystic_snake.name: Mystic Snake
medusa_mystic_snake.description: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
medusa_mystic_snake.facet_medusa_engorged: Mystic Snakes returning to Medusa empower her next %max_attacks% attacks with +1 additional damage for each %mana_per_damage% mana restored. Lasts up to %attack_buff_duration%s.
medusa_mystic_snake.lore: The Gorgon's curse is her greatest strength.

Stone Gaze must be drafted for Aghanim's Scepter upgrade to work.

medusa_gorgon_grasp.name: Gorgon's Grasp
medusa_gorgon_grasp.description: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.
medusa_gorgon_grasp.lore: The best predators don't even need to pounce.

medusa_stone_gaze.name: Stone Gaze
medusa_stone_gaze.description: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
medusa_stone_gaze.lore: The beauty of Medusa is legendary.
medusa_stone_gaze.note0: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.

naga_siren_mirror_image.description: Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
naga_siren_mirror_image.lore: Slithice, while being strong in her own right, is notoriously hard to track down.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note0: Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note1: Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
naga_siren_mirror_image.note2: Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

naga_siren_ensnare.name: Ensnare
naga_siren_ensnare.description: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
naga_siren_ensnare.lore: The only way to escape the onslaught of a Slithereen is to never oppose one in the first place.
naga_siren_ensnare.scepter_description: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

naga_siren_rip_tide.name: Rip Tide
naga_siren_rip_tide.description: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
naga_siren_rip_tide.note0: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.
naga_siren_rip_tide.lore: A torrent from the Deep Ones crushes the defenses of the Siren's enemies.

naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.name: Song of the Siren
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.description: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.shard_description: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.lore: Slithice's powerful voice enchants leagues of opponents, while calling her Slithereen kin in a time of need.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.note0: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.cancel_description: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.note2: The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.cancel_custom_description: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

tiny_avalanche.description: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
tiny_avalanche.lore: Inanimate rock becomes animate when called by the Stone Giant.

tiny_toss.name: Toss
tiny_toss.description: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
tiny_toss.shard_description: Increases radius. Tossed units slow and deal bonus damage to other targets at the Toss destination.
tiny_toss.lore: Tiny's gargantuan stature allows him to catapult even the sturdiest of warriors.
tiny_toss.note0: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
tiny_toss.note1: Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
tiny_toss.note2: Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.

tiny_toss.tree_lore: Even enemies can share in Tiny's arbor ardor.

tiny_tree_grab.name: Tree Grab
tiny_tree_grab.lore: Sticks and stones break all the bones, with structures sure to follow.
tiny_tree_grab.description: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
tiny_tree_grab.note0: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

tiny_grow.name: Grow
tiny_grow.description: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
tiny_grow.lore: Watching a hill become a mountain is awe-inspiring - especially if the mountain begins laying waste to adversaries.
tiny_grow.shard_description: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.name: Hunter in the Night
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.description: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.scepter_description: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.shard_description: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.facet_night_stalker_dayswap: Increases the max level of Hunter in the Night to %max_level_tooltip%. Night Stalker starts with a bonus level of Hunter in the Night.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.lore: The hunting prowess of Balanar improves as the night beckons.

night_stalker_void.name: Void
night_stalker_void.description: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
night_stalker_void.shard_description: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
night_stalker_void.facet_night_stalker_blinding_void: Enemies affected by Void do not share vision with their allies. Affected enemies take damage per second when they are not visible to their allies.
night_stalker_void.facet_night_stalker_voidbringer: Increases the max level of Void. Level %max_level% Void at night becomes ground targeted, increases movement and attack slow, and applies to a %cast_radius_tooltip% AoE.
night_stalker_void.invisible_damage_pers: DAMAGE PER SECOND WHEN NOT VISIBLE:
night_stalker_void.lore: Balanar creates a vortex of infinite night, tearing opponents violently into the eternal darkness that once was.
night_stalker_void.note0: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.

night_stalker_crippling_fear.name: Crippling Fear
night_stalker_crippling_fear.description: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.
night_stalker_crippling_fear.lore: A vision of the twisted maw of Balanar etches itself into the minds of the poor souls unlucky enough to cross his path.

night_stalker_darkness.name: Dark Ascension
night_stalker_darkness.description: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
night_stalker_darkness.lore: It is a humbling sight to see when the mightiest of warriors become afraid of the dark.
