necrophos_sadist.name: Sadist
necrophos_sadist.description: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
necrophos_sadist.note0: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
necrophos_sadist.note1: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

necrophos_death_pulse.name: Death Pulse
necrophos_death_pulse.description: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
necrophos_death_pulse.lore: Poor souls who succumb to Rotund'jere's plagues are recycled for future use.

necrophos_ghost_shroud.name: Ghost Shroud
necrophos_ghost_shroud.description: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
necrophos_ghost_shroud.lore: Rotund'jere uses the souls of his victims as bridge from life to afterlife.

necrophos_heartstopper_aura.name: Heartstopper Aura
necrophos_heartstopper_aura.description: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
necrophos_heartstopper_aura.lore: Those who come within a short distance of Necrophos can feel pestilence and plague in the air.
necrophos_heartstopper_aura.note0: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.

necrophos_reapers_scythe.name: Reaper's Scythe
necrophos_reapers_scythe.description: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
necrophos_reapers_scythe.lore: The amount of death and suffering in the air increases the power of Necrophos's plague magic.
necrophos_reapers_scythe.note0: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

nyx_assassin_mana_burn.name: Mana Burn
nyx_assassin_mana_burn.description: The hero burns enemy mana proportional to the damage dealt to them.

nyx_assassin_impale.name: Impale
nyx_assassin_impale.description: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
nyx_assassin_impale.lore: All zealot scarabs possess intimate knowledge of underground pathways, using them to their advantage.
nyx_assassin_impale.note0: The spikes move at %speed% units per second, over %length% range.
nyx_assassin_impale.note1: Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

nyx_assassin_jolt.name: Mind Flare
nyx_assassin_jolt.description: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
nyx_assassin_jolt.lore: Only those raised by the queen can use their minds to touch the world around them.
nyx_assassin_jolt.facet_nyx_assassin_burn_mana: Mind Flare burns mana equal to a percentage of the target's max mana.

nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.name: Spiked Carapace
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.description: When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.\n\nWhile Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.lore: While their carapace is relatively thin, it's guarded by a retractable field of razor-sharp spikes.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note0: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note1: Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled units.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note2: The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx.
nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.note3: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

nyx_assassin_vendetta.name: Vendetta
nyx_assassin_vendetta.shard_description: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. For the first %free_pathing_duration%s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.description: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.lore: The scarab kills for the glory of his queen.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.note1: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.note2: With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.

techies_mutually_assured_destruction.name: M.A.D.
techies_mutually_assured_destruction.description:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after %explosion_delay%s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.
techies_mutually_assured_destruction.shard_description: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant an M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.

techies_sticky_bomb.name: Sticky Bomb
techies_sticky_bomb.description: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.
techies_sticky_bomb.lore: Such revolutionary brilliance was meant to be shared.

techies_reactive_tazer.name: Reactive Tazer
techies_reactive_tazer.description:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.
techies_reactive_tazer.lore: A steady bomb hand prefers an abundance of personal space.

techies_suicide.name: Blast Off!
techies_suicide.description: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
techies_suicide.facet_techies_spleens_secret_sauce: Increased Blast Off! damage and self damage.
techies_suicide.note0: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.

techies_land_mines.name: Proximity Mines
techies_land_mines.description: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
techies_land_mines.note0: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
techies_land_mines.note1: Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
techies_land_mines.note2: Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
techies_land_mines.note3: Mines are triggered by invisible units.
techies_land_mines.note4: Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
techies_land_mines.note5: Debuff immune units will reveal mines, but not trigger detonation.

marci_special_delivery.name: Special Delivery
marci_special_delivery.description: The hero whistles to their courier, instantly teleporting it to them. After teleporting, the courier creates a shop area for %duration_tooltip% seconds.
marci_special_delivery.note0: Has a cast delay of %abilitycastpoint% sec.
marci_special_delivery.note1: If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.

marci_grapple.name: Dispose
marci_grapple.description: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.
marci_grapple.lore: Marci excels at removing obstacles from Princess Mirana's path.

marci_companion_run.name: Rebound
marci_companion_run.description:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
marci_companion_run.shard_description: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
marci_companion_run.facet_marci_pickmeup: When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination. The ally deals %ally_impact_damage_pct%%% of the Rebound damage to the enemies around it's destination.\n\n Will not apply to Rooted or Leashed allies.
marci_companion_run.facet_marci_fleeting_fury: If Marci has Unleash leveled, after landing from Rebound, Marci gains a %postjump_flurry_charges% strike Fury combo. If Unleash is already active, its duration is instead extended by %postjump_unleash_duration%s.\n\n If upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter, the resulting Unleashed pulse will not silence enemies.
marci_companion_run.lore: With a friendly or brazen boost, Marci can find her way into the midst of any fight.
marci_companion_run.note1: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.

marci_guardian.name: Bodyguard
marci_guardian.description: Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.\n\nWhen cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
marci_guardian.note0: Marci cannot cast Sidekick on herself.
marci_guardian.note1: Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
marci_guardian.lore: Marci learned at a young age that the best asset in a scrap is a steady companion.

marci_unleash.name: Unleash
marci_unleash.description: Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.\n\nMarci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
marci_unleash.scepter_description:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
marci_unleash.note0: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
marci_unleash.lore: Though some have sought to understand its origins, Marci rebuffs all attempts to divine the source of her power.

rubick_curiosity.name: Curiosity
rubick_curiosity.description:
Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus.

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

rubick_telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
rubick_telekinesis.description: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
rubick_telekinesis.shard_description: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to %max_land_distance% and throw delay is reduced to %shard_teammate_throw_delay% seconds.
rubick_telekinesis.lore: Even the Grandest Magus may use his powers for enjoyment.
rubick_telekinesis.note0: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
rubick_telekinesis.note1: When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.
rubick_telekinesis.land_description: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.
rubick_telekinesis.land_self_description: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.
rubick_telekinesis.land_custom_description: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.
rubick_telekinesis.land_self_custom_description: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

rubick_fade_bolt.name: Fade Bolt
rubick_fade_bolt.description: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.
rubick_fade_bolt.lore: Rubick's favorite spell for dispatching would-be assassins is a rather simple conjuration.

rubick_arcane_supremacy.name: Arcane Supremacy
rubick_arcane_supremacy.description: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.facet_rubick_arcane_accumulation: Casting a spell temporarily increases the area of effect for all subsequent spells.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.lore: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...
rubick_arcane_supremacy.note0: Break disables the gaining of new Arcane Accumulation stacks.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.note1: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing Arcane Accumulation stacks.

rubick_spell_steal.name: Spell Steal
rubick_spell_steal.description: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
rubick_spell_steal.facet_rubick_frugal_filch: Stolen spells also have lower mana cost.
rubick_spell_steal.scepter_description: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
rubick_spell_steal.shard_description: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
rubick_spell_steal.lore: ...but even their lesser magics can be a source of much utility.
rubick_spell_steal.note1: Not all abilities can be stolen.

huskar_blood_magic.name: Blood Magic
huskar_blood_magic.description:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

huskar_inner_fire.name: Inner Fire
huskar_inner_fire.description: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.
huskar_inner_fire.lore: Not even Huskar's own flesh can contain the unending expansion of his life force.

huskar_burning_spear.name: Burning Spear
huskar_burning_spear.description: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
huskar_burning_spear.facet_huskar_nothl_conflagration: Burning Spears also burns enemies for a percentage of their max health. Costs Max Health instead of Current Health.
huskar_burning_spear.scepter_description: Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.
huskar_burning_spear.lore: The Sacred Warrior ignites his weaponry after marking it with his own blood - causing far greater pain than he himself feels.
huskar_burning_spear.note0: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
huskar_burning_spear.note1: Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
huskar_burning_spear.note2: Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.

huskar_berserkers_blood.name: Berserker's Blood
huskar_berserkers_blood.description: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
huskar_berserkers_blood.shard_description:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
huskar_berserkers_blood.facet_huskar_cauterize: Berserker's Blood can be activated for a health cost. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
huskar_berserkers_blood.lore: After losing his birthright, Huskar gained a lethality in physical combat that is only heightened as his own blood is spilled.
huskar_berserkers_blood.note0: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.
huskar_berserkers_blood.reverse_custom_description: The higher the health, the stronger the hero. Increases his attack speed, magic resistance and health recovery depending on the current health. Recovery is equal to a share of the hero's agility.

huskar_life_break.name: Life Break
huskar_life_break.description: Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
huskar_life_break.facet_huskar_bloodbath: Life Break also slows enemies in a radius around the target.
huskar_life_break.facet_huskar_nothl_transfusion: Life Break also heals friendly units in a radius around the target.
huskar_life_break.scepter_description: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
huskar_life_break.lore: No matter the danger, Huskar thrusts himself into melees that only he can survive.
huskar_life_break.note0: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
huskar_life_break.note1: Slow works on Spell Immune units.

ursa_earthshock.name: Earthshock
ursa_earthshock.description: Ursa leaps forward %hop_distance% units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for %abilityduration% seconds.
ursa_earthshock.shard_description: Earthshock applies %fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit% Fury Swipes to enemies hit.

ursa_overpower.name: Overpower
ursa_overpower.lore: For a behemoth of his size, Ursa is deceptively nimble.
ursa_overpower.description: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
ursa_overpower.note0: Overpower isn't removed by Black King Bar.

ursa_fury_swipes.name: Fury Swipes
ursa_fury_swipes.lore: In nature, the wounded rarely survive the attacks of hungry predators.
ursa_fury_swipes.description: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after %bonus_reset_time% seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
ursa_fury_swipes.note0: Break disables the application of new stacks.
ursa_fury_swipes.note1: Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

ursa_enrage.name: Enrage
ursa_enrage.lore: Ulfsaar succumbs to his ancient spirit, becoming the most ferocious creature on the battlefield.
ursa_enrage.facet_ursa_grudge_bearer: When damaged during Enrage, Ursa gains bonus attack damage.
ursa_enrage.description: Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
ursa_enrage.scepter_description: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.

warlock_eldritch_summoning.name: Eldritch Summoning
warlock_eldritch_summoning.note1: Minor imps do not explode if killed by enemy heroes.
warlock_eldritch_summoning.description: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
warlock_eldritch_summoning.shard_description: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

warlock_fatal_bonds.name: Fatal Bonds
warlock_fatal_bonds.description: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
warlock_fatal_bonds.lore: An ancient incantation that links the vital energies of multiple lifeforms into one collective body.
warlock_fatal_bonds.note0: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
warlock_fatal_bonds.note1: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

warlock_shadow_word.name: Shadow Word
warlock_shadow_word.description: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
warlock_shadow_word.scepter_description: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.
warlock_shadow_word.lore: Demnok's arcane arts have a myriad of uses, allowing them to be powerful friendly enchantments or damaging curses.

warlock_upheaval.name: Upheaval
warlock_upheaval.description: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
warlock_upheaval.lore: Demnok manipulates space-time, impairing entire armies.
warlock_upheaval.note0: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
warlock_upheaval.shard_description: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

warlock_rain_of_chaos.name: Chaotic Offering
warlock_rain_of_chaos.description: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
warlock_rain_of_chaos.facet_warlock_golem: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.
warlock_rain_of_chaos.lore: Demnok unleashes the captive spirit in his Dreadwood staff, causing destruction in enemy ranks.
warlock_rain_of_chaos.note0: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.

pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold_custom.name: Fortune Favors the Bold
pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold_custom.description: The hero can use any abilities and items without turning towards the target, and their chance-based effects are increased.

pangolier_swashbuckle.name: Swashbuckle
pangolier_swashbuckle.description: Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.\n\nLucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
pangolier_swashbuckle.lore: The Pangolier's blade is even nimbler than his tongue.
pangolier_swashbuckle.note0: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.
pangolier_swashbuckle.note1: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

pangolier_shield_crash.name: Shield Crash
pangolier_shield_crash.description: Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.\n\nForward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
pangolier_shield_crash.facet_pangolier_double_jump: Pangolier can cast Shield Crash a second time mid-flight, dealing more damage and gaining more barrier. Longer flight time results in more damage and barrier increases.
pangolier_shield_crash.scepter_description: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.
pangolier_shield_crash.lore: Only in the midst of his enemies does the Pangolier truly thrive.

pangolier_lucky_shot.name: Lucky Shot
pangolier_lucky_shot.description: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.
pangolier_lucky_shot.lore: The Pangolier's blade is guided more often by whim than reason.

pangolier_gyroshell.name: Rolling Thunder
pangolier_gyroshell.description:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
pangolier_gyroshell.facet_pangolier_thunderbolt: Rolling Thunder movement and turn speed increased, but duration is decreased.
pangolier_gyroshell.lore: Where his ancestors sought only refuge, the Pangolier saw opportunity...
pangolier_gyroshell.note0: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
pangolier_gyroshell.note1: If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
pangolier_gyroshell.note2: It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
pangolier_gyroshell.stop_lore: Donté Panlin stops when he pleases.
pangolier_gyroshell.stop_custom_lore: Donté Panlin stops when he pleases.

jakiro_double_trouble.name: Double Trouble
jakiro_double_trouble.description: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
jakiro_double_trouble.facet_jakiro_twin_terror: Jakiro deals more damage with his double attacks.

jakiro_dual_breath.name: Dual Breath
jakiro_dual_breath.description: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
jakiro_dual_breath.lore: Pyrexae dragons have tremendously dangerous breath for each branch of the species; combining them is unimaginable.
jakiro_dual_breath.note0: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
jakiro_dual_breath.note1: Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
jakiro_dual_breath.note2: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

jakiro_ice_path.name: Ice Path
jakiro_ice_path.description: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
jakiro_ice_path.facet_jakiro_ice: Jakiro can choose to destroy the Ice Path at any time, stunning and damaging enemies again.
jakiro_ice_path.facet_jakiro_ice_breaker: Ice Path lasts longer and detonates upon expiration, dealing damage and stunning enemies a second time. Ice Path can be manually detonated early.
jakiro_ice_path.lore: Jakiro's cunning right head calls upon its frozen heritage, glazing the earth with blistering cold.
jakiro_ice_path.note0: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
jakiro_ice_path.note1: The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.
jakiro_ice_path.detonate_description: Destroy the Ice Path, dealing damage and stunning enemies.

jakiro_liquid_fire.name: Liquid Fire
jakiro_liquid_fire.description: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
jakiro_liquid_fire.lore: The left maw of Jakiro opens, laying waste to any in its path.
jakiro_liquid_fire.shard_description: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
jakiro_liquid_fire.note0: Works on both units and buildings.

jakiro_liquid_ice.name: Liquid Frost
jakiro_liquid_ice.description: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
jakiro_liquid_ice.lore: The right maw of Jakiro opens, punishing all with bitter frost.
jakiro_liquid_ice.shard_description: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

jakiro_macropyre.name: Macropyre
jakiro_macropyre.description: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
jakiro_macropyre.scepter_description: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.
jakiro_macropyre.lore: Ice and fire combine to rip the battlefield to shreds with extreme temperatures.
jakiro_macropyre.note0: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.

zeus_static_field.name: Static Field
zeus_static_field.description: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
zeus_static_field.facet_zuus_livewire: Static Field deals more damage to nearby enemies.
zeus_static_field.lore: The air crackles with static when the Thundergod walks the world.
zeus_static_field.abilitydraft_note: Static Field is associated to this ability and doesn't affect abilities other than Zeus'.

zeus_arc_lightning.name: Arc Lightning
zeus_arc_lightning.description: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.
zeus_arc_lightning.lore: Arc Lightning is Zeus' favorite spell to use against puny mortals.

zeus_lightning_bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
zeus_lightning_bolt.description: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
zeus_lightning_bolt.lore: A shocking punishment for rebellious heathen.
zeus_lightning_bolt.note0: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

zeus_heavenly_jump.name: Heavenly Jump
zeus_heavenly_jump.description: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

zeus_thundergods_wrath.name: Thundergod's Wrath
zeus_thundergods_wrath.description: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck. Search Radius: %radius%
zeus_thundergods_wrath.lore: The Lord of Heaven smites all who oppose him, near or far.

kez_switch_weapons.name: Switch Discipline
kez_switch_weapons.lore: As former followers of the Shodo, the leaders of the Kazurai Order can switch effortlessly between twin disciplines of martial mastery over sai and blade.
kez_switch_weapons.description:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
kez_switch_weapons.scepter_description:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

kez_echo_slash.name: Echo Slash
kez_echo_slash.description: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
kez_echo_slash.lore: Kez and his master Kraw have worked tirelessly to train the Kazurai new ways to keep the flyers off balance by improving upon ancient techniques.

kez_grappling_claw.name: Grappling Claw
kez_grappling_claw.description: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.
kez_grappling_claw.lore: The speed and agility of the Kazurai allows them to bring down even the highest-flying birds from the sky.

kez_kazurai_katana.name: Kazurai Katana
kez_kazurai_katana.lore: To fight back against the reach of Imperia and her Queensguard, the Kazurai had to become skilled in the ways of attrition.
kez_kazurai_katana.description:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. 

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
kez_kazurai_katana.shard_description: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

kez_raptor_dance.name: Raptor Dance
kez_raptor_dance.lore: Unleash the inner fury of the Flightless to feast on the essence of your foes.
kez_raptor_dance.description:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
kez_raptor_dance.note0: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

kez_falcon_rush.name: Falcon Rush
kez_falcon_rush.lore: An ancient Shodo technique used to hunt faster aerial foes, stealing the advantage and delivering multiple attacks within a single flap of their prey's panicking wings.
kez_falcon_rush.description: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.

kez_talon_toss.name: Talon Toss
kez_talon_toss.lore: The Shodo learned to rely upon distance and disorientation to survive against much stronger opposition.
kez_talon_toss.description: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
kez_talon_toss.note0: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

kez_shodo_sai.name: Shodo Sai
kez_shodo_sai.lore: The Shodo may have lost their way, but Kez and the Kazurai can still use Shodo knowledge for the good of the people.
kez_shodo_sai.description:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
kez_shodo_sai.shard_description: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

kez_ravens_veil.name: Raven's Veil
kez_ravens_veil.lore: Eying either threat or opportunity, Shodo masters slip instantly into shadow to reset the terms of any engagement in their own favor.
kez_ravens_veil.description: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark with Parry bonus to nearby enemies, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

winter_wyvern_eldwurms_edda.name: Eldwurm's Edda
winter_wyvern_eldwurms_edda.description: Grants the owner a consumable item, Eldwurm's Edda. It can be used to increase the current and maximum level of a selected basic ability by 1, and increase the owner's base Intelligence by %tooltip_int_pct%%% of its value at the moment of use.

winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.name: Arctic Burn
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.description: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%%% of their current health each second.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.scepter_description: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.lore: The same organ where some dragons stoke their inner flame is, in Auroth, a crucible of unimaginable cold. From deep within her frosty gullet, an exhalation sends enemies into burning agony.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.note0: Enemy units can only receive the Arctic Burn debuff once per cast.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.note1: Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to %attack_point%.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.note2: Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to %attack_point%.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.note3: The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.

winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.name: Splinter Blast
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.description: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%.
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.lore: Produced slowly by specialized vesicles in her frozen gullet, Winter Wyvern blast shards of ice at her enemies.
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.note0: The primary projectile moves at %projectile_speed% movement speed.
winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.note1: The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.

winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.name: Cold Embrace
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.description: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.facet_winter_wyvern_winterproof: Cold Embrace can be cast on buildings. Does not heal buildings. Allied units and buildings gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon. Duration is paused if the building is protected by both Glyph of Fortification and Cold Embrace.
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.shard_description: Reduces cooldown by %shard_cooldown_reduction% seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.abilitydraft_note: Shard upgrade requires also drafting Splinter Blast.
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.lore: From winter's heart comes a cold, healing embrace. The ice slows the blood and allows the spell to better work its curative magic.

winter_wyvern_winters_curse.name: Winter's Curse
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.description: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units.
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.lore: The oldest of the bookwurm's spells, this curse lends truth to the old saw: sometimes the enemy of my enemy is my enemy still.
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.note0: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
winter_wyvern_winters_curse.note1: Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.

luna_lunar_blessing.name: Lunar Blessing
luna_lunar_blessing.description: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within %radius% range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.
luna_lunar_blessing.lore: The Goddess of the Moon smiles upon her kin.

luna_lucent_beam.name: Lucent Beam
luna_lucent_beam.shard_description: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant %damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%% of the damage amount.
luna_lucent_beam.description: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
luna_lucent_beam.lore: Selemene smites those who encroach upon the Nightsilver Woods.

luna_lunar_orbit.name: Lunar Orbit
luna_lunar_orbit.description: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
luna_lunar_orbit.lore: None may approach Selemene's chosen without favor from the goddess herself.
luna_lunar_orbit.facet_luna_moonshield: Rotating glaives provide damage reduction while active.
luna_lunar_orbit.shard_description: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed.

luna_moon_glaive.name: Moon Glaives
luna_moon_glaive.description: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
luna_moon_glaive.lore: Carefully sharpened, Luna's boomerang-like weapon cuts a wide swath through enemy numbers.
luna_moon_glaive.note0: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.
luna_moon_glaive.abilitydraft_note: Moon Glaives work on all melee heroes.

luna_eclipse.name: Eclipse
luna_eclipse.lore: In times of great need, Selemene herself descends into the world, blocking out the light and hope of the opposed.
luna_eclipse.description: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
luna_eclipse.scepter_description: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.
luna_eclipse.note0: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
luna_eclipse.note1: Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
luna_eclipse.note3: There is a %beam_interval% seconds gap between beams, %beam_interval_scepter% seconds with scepter.
luna_eclipse.abilitydraft_note: Must draft Lucent Beam as well to work.

axe_one_man_army.name: One Man Army
axe_one_man_army.description: Axe gains Strength based on %armor_pct_as_strength%%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within %radius% distance from Axe.  The effect fades over %bonus_linger_duration%s after approaching an ally.

axe_berserkers_call.name: Berserker's Call
axe_berserkers_call.description: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
axe_berserkers_call.shard_description: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
axe_berserkers_call.facet_axe_call_out: Berserker's Call gives Axe increased bonus armor and increases the attack speed of the affected units.
axe_berserkers_call.abilitydraft_note: Must draft Battle Hunger for Scepter upgrade to work.
axe_berserkers_call.lore: Mogul Khan's warcry taunts opponents into engaging in an unconquerable battle with the Axe.

axe_battle_hunger.name: Battle Hunger
axe_battle_hunger.description: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
axe_battle_hunger.shard_description: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.
axe_battle_hunger.note0: This effect is also removed if a building is destroyed.
axe_battle_hunger.lore: Ordinary heroes cannot withstand Mogul Khan's rage for battle, such that it injures them until it is satisfied.

axe_counter_helix.name: Counter Helix
axe_counter_helix.description: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
axe_counter_helix.scepter_description: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
axe_counter_helix.note0: Triggers upon completion of an attack on the caster.
axe_counter_helix.note1: Illusions' attacks are not counted toward the trigger when using Aghanim's Scepter.
axe_counter_helix.lore: Axe is the only reinforcement this army needs.

axe_culling_blade.name: Culling Blade
axe_culling_blade.description: Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.\n\nAxe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
axe_culling_blade.note0: This kill cannot be prevented by abilities like Shallow Grave.
axe_culling_blade.lore: Mogul Khan is the embodiment of battle and fury, launching into a gruesome fatality against those who dare engage the Axe in combat.

io_equilibrium.name: Equilibrium
io_equilibrium.description: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

io_tether.name: Tether
io_tether.description: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
io_tether.lore: The Eternal's benevolent touch fills others with interdimensional power.
io_tether.note0: If you attempt to tether to an ally 700 units or more away, you will be pulled to within 300 units of them.
io_tether.note1: A tethered ally regenerates health and mana faster, even if Io is at full health.
io_tether.note2: Io's movement speed is matched to that of the tethered ally.

io_spirits.name: Spirits
io_spirits.description: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
io_spirits.lore: With unthinkable might, the Eternal spins the very particles of the universe.
io_spirits.note0: After summoning, Io can move the spirits closer or farther away.
io_spirits.in_custom_description: Pulls the spirits closer to Io. Recast to stop the movement.
io_spirits.out_custom_description: Pushes the spirits away from Io. Recast to stop the movement.

io_overcharge.name: Overcharge
io_overcharge.lore: By drawing cosmic energy from all realms, the Eternal begins to unravel time.
io_overcharge.description: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

io_relocate.name: Relocate
io_relocate.lore: Io is the embodiment of the universe's mysteries.
io_relocate.description: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
io_relocate.note0: Enemies see the teleport destination both in-game and on the minimap once the spell is cast.
io_relocate.note1: If stunned during the cast time, the teleport is canceled.
io_relocate.note2: If you are tethered to an ally, they will teleport with you. To prevent this, break the tether before teleporting.
io_relocate.note3: Only heroes, hero creeps, and illusions can be teleported.

phoenix_dying_light.name: Dying Light
phoenix_dying_light.description: Phoenix deals %damage_pct%%% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a %radius% radius every second.
phoenix_dying_light.note0: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.

phoenix_icarus_dive.name: Icarus Dive
phoenix_icarus_dive.description: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
phoenix_icarus_dive.lore: Though space is a familiar realm to this being, flight beneath the atmospheric dome brings unparalleled joy.
phoenix_icarus_dive.note0: The dive lasts for %dive_duration% seconds. It can be interrupted by reactivating the ability.

phoenix_fire_spirits.name: Fire Spirits
phoenix_fire_spirits.description: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
phoenix_fire_spirits.shard_description: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.
phoenix_fire_spirits.note0: Spirits provide vision at the impact location for 1 second.
phoenix_fire_spirits.lore: A collapsing stellar core often emits fleeting pulses of sentient light.

phoenix_sun_ray.name: Sun Ray
phoenix_sun_ray.description: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
phoenix_sun_ray.shard_description: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.
phoenix_sun_ray.abilitydraft_note: In Ability Draft, Sun Ray movement is disabled.  The hero can only turn in place while Sun Ray is active.
phoenix_sun_ray.lore: Currents that carry stellar energy span no wider than a few atoms.
phoenix_sun_ray.note1: Effect ends if stunned, silenced, hexed, slept, or lifted.
phoenix_sun_ray.note2: Using items or other abilities does not cancel Sun Ray.
phoenix_sun_ray.toggle_move_description: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
phoenix_sun_ray.toggle_move_note0: Sun Ray allows Phoenix to move over cliffs and trees.
phoenix_sun_ray.toggle_move_custom_description: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
phoenix_sun_ray.toggle_move_custom_note0: Allows flying over obstacles and trees.

phoenix_sun_ray_toggle_move.name: Toggle Movement
phoenix_sun_ray_toggle_move.description: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
phoenix_sun_ray_toggle_move.note0: Allows flying over obstacles and trees.

phoenix_supernova.name: Supernova
phoenix_supernova.description: The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After %abilityduration% seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.\n\nDISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
phoenix_supernova.scepter_description: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.
phoenix_supernova.lore: The solar blaze of a supernova may be deadly, but from its flames burst infinite new rays.

razor_plasma_field.name: Plasma Field
razor_plasma_field.description: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.
razor_plasma_field.lore: Plasma power keeps the underworld in the grasp of the lightning ghost.

razor_static_link.name: Static Link
razor_static_link.description: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
razor_static_link.shard_description: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.
razor_static_link.lore: The polarity of the lightning ghost draws electricity, draining strength from its opposites.
razor_static_link.note0: The link will break early if the target dies or moves more than %drain_range_buffer% away from the cast range.

razor_storm_surge.name: Storm Surge
razor_storm_surge.description: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
razor_storm_surge.shard_description: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.
razor_storm_surge.lore: Those who approach the lightning ghost are in for a shocking surprise.
razor_storm_surge.note0: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

razor_eye_of_the_storm.name: Eye of the Storm
razor_eye_of_the_storm.description: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor. Maximum Stacks: 20
razor_eye_of_the_storm.scepter_description: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
razor_eye_of_the_storm.lore: Like a bolt from the blue.
razor_eye_of_the_storm.note0: Each strike targets the enemy with the lowest health in the area.
razor_eye_of_the_storm.note1: The cloud prioritizes heroes affected by Static Link.
razor_eye_of_the_storm.note2: Effects from multiple instances of the ability stack.

void_spirit_intrinsic_edge.name: Intrinsic Edge
void_spirit_intrinsic_edge.description: Void Spirit gains %damage_stat_bonus_pct%%% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and %secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

void_spirit_aether_remnant.name: Aether Remnant
void_spirit_aether_remnant.description: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
void_spirit_aether_remnant.shard_description: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.
void_spirit_aether_remnant.lore: Inai exists not in a single point of space and time.

void_spirit_dissimilate.name: Dissimilate
void_spirit_dissimilate.description: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
void_spirit_dissimilate.facet_void_spirit_aether_artifice: Upon exiting Dissimilate, Aether Remnants are created at the %aether_remnant_count% portals furthest from Void Spirit. No effect if reassembling from the center portal. Remnants face towards the center portal and have reduced pull duration and damage.
void_spirit_dissimilate.lore: Inai prefers to observe our world without burdening himself with a material form.
void_spirit_dissimilate.note0: Aether Remnant copies do not appear in the outer ring with Call of the Void aspect.
void_spirit_dissimilate.burst_description: After a short delay, creates a Dissimilate explosion at the target point.

void_spirit_resonant_pulse.name: Resonant Pulse
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.description: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.facet_void_spirit_sanctuary: Resonant Pulse creates a larger all damage barrier instead of a physical barrier.
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.scepter_description: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.lore: Inai shelters himself in his true form when he must engage with the mortal world.

void_spirit_astral_step.name: Astral Step
void_spirit_astral_step.description: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
void_spirit_astral_step.note0: Attacks from this ability do not deal cleave damage.
void_spirit_astral_step.lore: A single step by Inai brings devastation to the mortal realm.

sniper_keen_scope.name: Keen Scope
sniper_keen_scope.description: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.

sniper_shrapnel.name: Shrapnel
sniper_shrapnel.description: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
sniper_shrapnel.facet_sniper_scattershot: Shrapnel slow and damage are increased, but duration is decreased.
sniper_shrapnel.lore: Cardel’s versatile rifle can fire incendiary rounds, especially effective in trench warfare.
sniper_shrapnel.note0: Deals damage 11 times — upon activation and once each second thereafter.
sniper_shrapnel.note1: Does not deal damage to buildings.
sniper_shrapnel.note2: Reveals the fog of war in the affected area.

sniper_headshot.name: Headshot
sniper_headshot.description: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal %damage% extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by %slow%%%.
sniper_headshot.lore: Hunting mountain beasts, young Cardel perfected the art of tracking enemy movement.

sniper_take_aim.name: Take Aim
sniper_take_aim.description: Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.\n\nOn cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.
sniper_take_aim.lore: Cardel always tries to stay as far from danger as possible, without forgetting his main goal: precise shooting.

sniper_assassinate.name: Assassinate
sniper_assassinate.description: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
sniper_assassinate.scepter_description: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
sniper_assassinate.lore: To fulfill the prophecy and return home, Cardel must ensure his next shot is as true as the one he fired on the day of his trial.
sniper_assassinate.note0: The targeting icon is only visible to allies.
sniper_assassinate.note1: The projectile cannot be disjointed by invisibility.

monkey_king_mischief.name: Mischief
monkey_king_mischief.description: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.
monkey_king_mischief.lore: When you never know where danger will come from.

monkey_king_boundless_strike.name: Boundless Strike
monkey_king_boundless_strike.description: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
monkey_king_boundless_strike.lore: The legendary staff Jingu Bang grows at its master’s will, ensuring enemies cannot escape its grasp.
monkey_king_boundless_strike.shard_description: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.

monkey_king_tree_dance.name: Tree Dance
monkey_king_tree_dance.description: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
monkey_king_tree_dance.facet_monkey_king_simian_stride: Increases the max level of Tree Dance. Level %max_level% Tree Dance reduces the cooldown to zero.
monkey_king_tree_dance.lore: Sun Wukong nimbly leaps through the forest canopy, staying out of reach no matter what.
monkey_king_tree_dance.note0: The cooldown of this ability begins upon landing.
monkey_king_tree_dance.note1: You can dismount from the tree by issuing a move command.
monkey_king_tree_dance.note2: Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
monkey_king_tree_dance.abilitydraft_note: For Ability Draft only, Tree Dance ability swaps with Primal Spring while you are perched on a tree. You can no longer jump to other trees without returning to the ground first.

monkey_king_primal_spring.name: Primal Spring
monkey_king_primal_spring.description: CHANNELED - Monkey King springs out from his tree perch, damaging and slowing enemies in the area where he lands. Damage and slow amounts are in proportion to channel duration.
monkey_king_primal_spring.lore: Leaping from concealment into the midst of his enemies, Sun Wukong strikes without mercy.

monkey_king_jingu_mastery.name: Jingu Mastery
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.description: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.lore: Sensitive to its master’s spirit, Jingu Bang shines with power when Sun Wukong shows his battle fervor.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note0: A hit with Boundless Strike also increments the attack counter.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note1: The effect on an enemy is refreshed with each attack.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note2: The attack counter on an enemy cannot be dispelled.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note3: The effect that grants the owner empowered attacks can be dispelled.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note4: Gaining new effects is disabled by Break.
monkey_king_jingu_mastery.note5: Existing effects are not removed by Break.

monkey_king_mischief.name: Mischief
monkey_king_mischief.description: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.
monkey_king_mischief.lore: When you never know where danger will come from.

monkey_king_wukongs_command.name: Wukong's Command
monkey_king_wukongs_command.description:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.facet_monkey_king_wukongs_faithful: Monkey King's soldiers last longer and do not disperse unless he spends more than %leadership_time_buffer% seconds outside the area.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.facet_monkey_king_transfiguration: Grants the Changing of the Guard ability during Wukong's Command.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.scepter_description: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.lore: Sun Wukong plucks a tuft of fur and blows it at his enemies, turning each hair into a copy of himself.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.note0: Soldiers do not benefit from Jingu Mastery.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.note1: Soldier attacks do not trigger Skull Basher or Abyssal Blade effects.

riki_backstab.name: Backstab
riki_backstab.description: When attacking from behind, the hero deals additional damage based on agility.
riki_backstab.note0: When last-hitting allied units, it works at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
riki_backstab.note1: Illusions also have backstab attack animation, but they deal no bonus damage.

riki_smoke_screen.name: Smoke Screen
riki_smoke_screen.description: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
riki_smoke_screen.lore: The Silent Assassin highly values a simple smoke screen that confuses his enemies, for on a fateful night it saved him from traitors.
riki_smoke_screen.note0: Can be used while under Tricks of the Trade.
riki_smoke_screen.shard_description: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.

riki_blink_strike.name: Blink Strike
riki_blink_strike.description: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
riki_blink_strike.lore: No one escapes the nimble assassin.
riki_blink_strike.note2: This ability can be used on allies, and they will not take damage.
riki_blink_strike.note0: The first attack after using this ability will be made from behind.
riki_blink_strike.note1: The ability’s damage is applied before the next attack.

riki_tricks_of_the_trade.name: Tricks of the Trade
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.description: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.note1: Backstab damage is applied to all units hit.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.facet_riki_exterminator: Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.scepter_description: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.lore: The stealthy assassin believes that in battle, all means are fair, and does not hesitate to strike from behind.

riki_permanent_invisibility.name: Cloak and Dagger
riki_permanent_invisibility.description: The hero merges with the shadows, remaining barely visible until he attacks or approaches an enemy hero too quickly. Participating in kills grants additional experience.

faceless_void_distortion_field.name: Distortion Field
faceless_void_distortion_field.description: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a %friendly_hero_distance% radius of him get slowed by %attack_projectile_slow%%%, when they get  within %slow_distance_max% distance of their target.

faceless_void_time_walk.name: Time Walk
faceless_void_time_walk.description: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
faceless_void_time_walk.scepter_description: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.
faceless_void_time_walk.lore: Darkterror tears through the fabric of time, passing through Claszureme and instantly returning back.
faceless_void_time_walk.note0: While this ability is active, the hero is invulnerable.
faceless_void_time_walk.reverse_description: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.
faceless_void_time_walk.reverse_custom_description: Can be used within 1.5s after Time Walk to return to the previous position.

faceless_void_time_dilation.name: Time Dilation
faceless_void_time_dilation.description: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
faceless_void_time_dilation.shard_description: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.
faceless_void_time_dilation.lore: For those who fight Darkterror, every moment stretches into eternity.
faceless_void_time_dilation.note1: Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.

faceless_void_time_lock.name: Time Lock
faceless_void_time_lock.description: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
faceless_void_time_lock.lore: Darkterror’s strikes can knock his foes into another dimension.
faceless_void_time_lock.note0: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
faceless_void_time_lock.abilitydraft_note: In Ability Draft, does stack with Skull Basher.

faceless_void_chronosphere.name: Chronosphere
faceless_void_chronosphere.description: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
faceless_void_chronosphere.lore: When a passage to Claszureme opens, those caught inside rarely return.
faceless_void_chronosphere.note0: All units and buildings are frozen except those controlled by the caster.
faceless_void_chronosphere.note1: Faceless Void is not frozen inside the sphere, even if cast by another player.
faceless_void_chronosphere.abilitydraft_note: Faceless Void can move freely within the Chronosphere without drafting Chronosphere and regardless of team.

lina_dragon_slave.name: Dragon Slave
lina_dragon_slave.description: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
lina_dragon_slave.lore: In the scorched barren of Misrule, Lina learned to manipulate the fiery breath of the Desert Wyrm as a form of entertainment.
lina_dragon_slave.note0: Hits units up to 1225 units away.
lina_dragon_slave.note1: This ability cannot be blocked or reflected.

lina_light_strike_array.name: Light Strike Array
lina_light_strike_array.description: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
lina_light_strike_array.lore: Lina's essence allows her to focus the sun's energies, causing air to combust at will.
lina_light_strike_array.note0: Destroys trees in the area of effect.

lina_fiery_soul.name: Fiery Soul
lina_fiery_soul.description: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts %fiery_soul_stack_duration% seconds.
lina_fiery_soul.shard_description: Lina's abilities deal %shard_bonus_spell_damage% more damage for each Fiery Soul Charge.
lina_fiery_soul.lore: Dancing flames embody Lina's playful nature, bringing out her true blazing self.
lina_fiery_soul.note0: Hitting an enemy with any spell refreshes the duration.
lina_fiery_soul.note1: Does not trigger from item usage.

lina_laguna_blade.name: Laguna Blade
lina_laguna_blade.description: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
lina_laguna_blade.facet_lina_supercharge: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
lina_laguna_blade.shard_description: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
lina_laguna_blade.lore: The air around Lina becomes so intensely torrid that it scorches a foe that comes too close with white-hot lightning.
lina_laguna_blade.note0: There is a %damage_delay%-second delay between cast and damage, allowing the target to avoid it.

keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed.name: Bright Speed
keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed.description:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.

keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.name: Illuminate
keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.description: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.lore: The light hidden within Ezalor manifests in wondrous form.

keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.name: Blinding Light
keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.description: Creates a flash of blinding light at the target location, knocking back and blinding all enemies, causing their attacks to miss. Enemies are knocked back %knockback_distance_tooltip% units over %knockback_duration% seconds.
keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.note0: Knocked-back units destroy trees in a 150 radius upon landing.
keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.lore: The primal light bends the course of battle in favor of Ezalor and his allies.

keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.name: Chakra Magic
keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.description: Restores mana and reduces the cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown. Has %self_bonus%%% increased effect when cast on self.
keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.lore: In this way, Ezalor is able to bestow harmony upon others.
keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.note0: Does not reduce the cooldown of ultimate abilities.

keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.name: Spirit Form
keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.description: Transforms the hero's body into pure light, granting increased cast range and enhancing the movement speed bonus from Bright Speed. In this form, Illuminate is cast by a separate spirit and heals allies.
keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.facet_keeper_of_the_light_facet_solar_bi: Grants the Solar Bind ability while active.
keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.facet_keeper_of_the_light_facet_recall: Grants the Recall ability while active.
keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.lore: Ezalor reveals his true nature in a brilliant flash of light.

tinker_laser.description: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.

tinker_laser.lore: In his underground laboratory, Boush perfected this laser cutter for hard rock, never considering its use in combat.

tinker_deploy_turrets.description: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point.
