dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.name: Break of Dawn
dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.description: At sunrise, the hero gains increased vision and base damage.
dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.scepter_description: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.name: Starbreaker
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.lore: Among countless starborn heirs, many refused to follow the will of the Children of Radiance. To those who dared resist, the Children sent hammer-wielding Valor to show their power — and the dissenters either met their downfall or returned to the true path.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.description: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note0: While using this ability, the hero moves at %movement_speed%, and recovers from the final swing after %self_stun_duration% sec.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note1: Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be used while this ability is active.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note2: Attacks from this ability do not trigger cleave.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note3: Can be cast on self to move forward.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.note4: The first two swings slow enemies by %swipe_slow%% for %sweep_stun_duration% sec.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.swipe_damage: BONUS DAMAGE FROM SWINGS AND SMASH:
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.shard_description: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.facet_dawnbreaker_blaze: Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.

descriptions.swipe_damage: BONUS DAMAGE FROM SWINGS AND SMASH:

dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.name: Celestial Hammer
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.lore: Only the hammer, Lucent — Valor's oldest companion — connects her to the radiance of the creators.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.facet_dawnbreaker_gleaming_hammer: When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.description: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.note0: The hammer damages enemies both on the throw and on the return.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.note1: The hero's flight distance cannot exceed the range of this ability.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.note2: Starbreaker cannot be used if the hero does not have the hammer in hand.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.facet_dawnbreaker_hearthfire: Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.
dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.facet_dawnbreaker_brightmaul_wake: Enemies hit by Celestial Hammer will count as Luminosity attacks. Luminosity's crit will apply to Celestial Hammer.

dawnbreaker_luminosity.name: Luminosity
dawnbreaker_luminosity.lore: Valor is weakened without the reinforcing light of the Children of Radiance, yet she can still empower allies, bringing order to the chaos inherent in every battle.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.description: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.scepter_description: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.facet_dawnbreaker_solar_charged: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.note0: Healing from this ability is increased by lifesteal.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.note1: Receiving effects is disabled by exhaustion.

dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.name: Solar Guardian
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.lore: Valor is willing to call upon the last remnants of her former strength to soar on the wings of the cosmos, solely to protect her allies.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.description:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.note1: The ability takes %abilitychanneltime% sec. to cast and %airtime_duration% sec. to fly.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.note2: Cannot be cast without the hammer.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.scepter_description: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.

chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.name: Fundamental Forging
chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.description: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.note0: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.note1: The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.

chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.name: Chaos Bolt
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.description: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.shard_description: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals %illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%% less damage.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.lore: Even the Chaos Knight cannot predict the behavior of this mass of unholy energy.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.note0: Stun duration and damage are inversely proportional.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.note1: Nearby illusions mimic the throw animation.

chaos_knight_reality_rift.name: Reality Rift
chaos_knight_reality_rift.description: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.shard_description: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.facet_chaos_knight_irrationality: Reality Rift has equal chances of applying Break, Disarm, or Silence for %additional_debuff_duration_percent%%% of the base debuff duration in addition to its normal effects.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.lore: Armageddon moves between worlds, delivering its rider to the target wherever they may be.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.note0: The hero and the target face each other, after which the caster and their illusions immediately attack the target.

chaos_knight_chaos_strike.name: Chaos Strike
chaos_knight_chaos_strike.description: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.
chaos_knight_chaos_strike.lore: The unstoppable power of the rider crushes even the thickest armor of those who dare oppose him.

chaos_knight_phantasm.name: Phantasm
chaos_knight_phantasm.description: Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.\nDISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
chaos_knight_phantasm.scepter_description:
Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
chaos_knight_phantasm.lore: The harbinger of chaos has fought in many worlds and eras. Phantoms of those battles join the hero to crush his enemies.
chaos_knight_phantasm.note0: Removes most negative effects from the hero.
chaos_knight_phantasm.note1: For the first %invuln_duration% sec. of this ability, the hero is invulnerable, avoiding stuns and damage.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_description: All Chaos Knight Illusions are Strong Illusions and take less damage when near him.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_note0: All illusions created by Chaos Knight or of Chaos Knight are Strong Illusions. Chaos Knight's Illusions within %aura_radius% radius have %damage_reduction_pct%%% damage reduction.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_note1: Also applies to Aghanim's Scepter Phantasm Illusions.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_note2: Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
chaos_knight_phantasm.agoria_note3: Break disables the passive Damage Reduction aura.

ogre_magi_dumb_luck.name: Dumb Luck
ogre_magi_dumb_luck.description: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

ogre_magi_fireblast.name: Fireblast
ogre_magi_fireblast.description: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
ogre_magi_fireblast.lore: Ogres are easily amused—they can spend hours entertaining themselves by playing with fire.
ogre_magi_fireblast.note0: When Multicast triggers, each additional stun is applied with a %multicast_delay% sec. delay.
ogre_magi_fireblast.scepter_description: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.

ogre_magi_ignite.name: Ignite
ogre_magi_ignite.description: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
ogre_magi_ignite.note0: Multicast Bonus: This ability has a chance to affect random enemies within %ignite_multicast_aoe% radius.
ogre_magi_ignite.note1: Reapplying this ability extends the duration of the existing effect.

ogre_magi_bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
ogre_magi_bloodlust.description: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
ogre_magi_bloodlust.lore: Running is boring... Let's fight instead!
ogre_magi_bloodlust.note0: Multicast Bonus: May affect multiple allied units within a %multicast_bloodlust_aoe% radius.

ogre_magi_multicast.name: Multicast
ogre_magi_multicast.description: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every %strength_for_one_pct% Strength adds %one_tooltip%%%.
ogre_magi_multicast.facet_ogre_magi_fat_chance: Each point of Ogre Magi's Strength adds %strength_mult%%% to Ogre Magi's Multicast chance.
ogre_magi_multicast.lore: Ogres may lack brains, but sheer luck is all the skill they need to succeed in battle.
ogre_magi_multicast.note0: Only targeted abilities and items can Multicast.
ogre_magi_multicast.note1: Targeted abilities and items affect additional enemies and neutral creeps within a certain radius of the hero. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast instead hit the same target multiple times.

visage_silent_as_the_grave.name: Silent as the Grave
visage_silent_as_the_grave.description: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.
visage_silent_as_the_grave.scepter_description: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.
visage_silent_as_the_grave.lore: The denizens of the mortal realm are blind to the subtle purpose of those who carry out the will of the afterlife.

visage_grave_chill.name: Grave Chill
visage_grave_chill.description: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
visage_grave_chill.lore: The warmth of sunlight has never reached the dark and frigid corridors of the Narrow Maze.
visage_grave_chill.note0: The effects on Visage and the target can be dispelled independently.
visage_grave_chill.note1: The amount of speed gained is independent of the amount stolen.
visage_grave_chill.note2: Familiars within %radius% radius of their owner also gain the bonuses from this ability.

visage_soul_assumption.name: Soul Assumption
visage_soul_assumption.description: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
visage_soul_assumption.facet_visage_gold_assumption: Soul Assumption kills give %bonus_soul_charge_gold% gold per soul charge, up to %bonus_gold_max_tooltip% gold. Reduced gold from creeps. Enemy heroes killed within %gold_grace_period_hero%s of being affected by Soul Assumption also give gold.
visage_soul_assumption.lore: The gathered souls of the dead burst forth to claim another for their flock.
visage_soul_assumption.note0: Charges are only gained for damage greater than %damage_min% and less than %damage_max% that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
visage_soul_assumption.soul_charge_gold: BONUS GOLD PER CHARGE PER KILL:

visage_gravekeepers_cloak.name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.description:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.shard_description: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.lore: The Familiar's sturdy scales possess both the qualities of stone and spirit, rendering it nearly impervious to blade and spell alike.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.note0: Taking at least the minimum damage from another player removes one layer.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.note1: Familiars within %radius% radius receive the same protection from Gravekeeper's Cloak as their owner.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.note2: Gaining new layers is disabled by Break.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.note3: Existing layers are not disabled by Break.

visage_summon_familiars.name: Summon Familiars
visage_summon_familiars.description: Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.\n\nThe ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
visage_summon_familiars.facet_visage_faithful_followers:
Familiars will automatically attack the target Visage tried to attack last, and will return if that target is out of Visage's attack range, or Visage issues the cancel current action or hold position commands.

The ability can be toggled to the Auto-Cast state to command the Familiars to return to Visage and not leave his side until the state has been disabled.
visage_summon_familiars.recall_description: Recall this familiar to Visage after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
visage_summon_familiars.facet_visage_sepulchre: The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
visage_summon_familiars.facet_visage_gold_assumption: The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
visage_summon_familiars.lore: Guardians of the Narrow Maze, Necro'lic's servants tirelessly watch over his domain.
visage_summon_familiars.note0: Casting this ability replaces existing Familiars with new ones.
visage_summon_familiars.note1: Familiars near the hero receive the same protection from Gravekeeper's Cloak as their owner.
visage_summon_familiars.stone_form_description:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After %stone_duration% seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.
visage_summon_familiars.recall_custom_description: Recall this familiar to Visage after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
